**Special Rules:** When the first Hero enters the true ambush marker, place **1 Giant Scorpion** if **APL** is **1–2**, **1 Desert Naga** if **APL** is **3–4**, or **1d2 Desert Nagas** if **APL** is **5+**, adjacent to that Hero, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Ambushers are **Awake** and roll the base damage dice of their first attack with **Advantage**.

**9. Collapsing Dune Hazard.**
**Setup:** Designate one large Sand Dune.
**Special Rules:** If a combatant ends their activation on top of the Sand Dune, or if an Explosion occurs within **2"** of it, the dune face collapses. Each combatant on the dune must make a **DEX Check**. On a failure, **Slide** that combatant **3"** down the dune; they become **Prone** and suffer **1d4 blunt damage**. After the collapse, the slope becomes **Difficult Terrain**.

**10. Nomad's Hidden Water Stash.**
**Setup:** Place three "Cairns" at least **8"** apart. Randomly assign one **Water** marker and two **Blank** markers face down beneath them before play.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make a **STR Check** to dismantle.
**Reward:** The correct Cairn reveals **1d2 Waterskins**. When an incorrect Cairn is dismantled, roll **1d3**: on a **1**, it contains nothing; on a **2**, place **1 Giant Scorpion** if **APL** is **1–2**, or **1 Desert Naga** if **APL** is **3+**, adjacent to that Hero, using the canonical bestiary entry; the placed Monster is **Awake** and hostile; on a **3**, it contains **(2 + (4 × APL))/2 Coins**, minimum **1c**. The first party to find the Waterskins claims them.

**11. Vulture's Eye on the Fallen.**
**Setup:** None initially.
**Interact [1 AP]:** An adjacent ally spends **1 AP** to protect the Fallen Hero, driving off the vultures and removing the Vulture Flock marker.
**Special Rules:** The first time a Hero is reduced to **0 HP** and remains **Knocked Out**, immediately place a **Vulture Flock** marker over them. If no adjacent ally uses **Interact [1 AP]** before the end of the next **Party Phase** that begins after the marker is placed, that Hero suffers **-2** on their next Injuries Roll in campaign play. Outside campaign play, that Hero's party loses **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** in dropped gear instead. Then remove the marker.

**12. Scorched Earth Scar.**
**Setup:** Designate an **Aura 3"** area as scorched ground. The area is **Difficult Terrain**, and a combatant ending their activation in it suffers 1 fire damage. Place a **Heart of Cinder** marker at its centre.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make a **STR Check** to claim the Heart.
**Reward:** The Heart of Cinder is worth **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, or it may be used once as **[0 AP]** to make one weapon deal an additional **1d6 fire damage** until the end of the round.

**13. Tomb Dead Awakening.**
**Setup:** Designate one ruined structure as the "Sealed Tomb".
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make an **INT Check** to search the tomb.
**Success:** The Hero gains **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Reward:** Defeating every Tomb Dead yields their normal **CV** plus **Burial Silks** worth **5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The first time a Hero loots any Treasure Chest within **6"** of the Sealed Tomb or searches the Sealed Tomb, place **2 Skeleton Warriors** if **APL** is **1–2**, or **1 Mummy** if **APL** is **3+**, within the Sealed Tomb, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Tomb Dead are **Awake** and hostile.

**14. Whispering Winds of Prophecy.**
**Setup:** None.
**Trigger:** At the start of Round 2, each party chooses one of its Heroes to hear the whispers.
**Reward:** Each chosen Hero's party gains **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. Each chosen Hero gains **Advantage** on the first **Check** they make as part of an **Interact** action this adventure.

**15. Desert Bloom Oasis (Fleeting).**
**Setup:** At the start of Round 3, use **Random Direction** from the battlefield centre. Place the centre of the "Fleeting Oasis" (2"×2") **9"** from the battlefield centre in the rolled direction, with the entire area in **Open Terrain** and at least **6"** from every battlefield edge. If that position is illegal, place the Oasis in the nearest legal position to the rolled position that satisfies those requirements. Resolve exact ties with **Random Determination**.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Drink.
**Reward:** The Oasis provides **2** Drinks total. Each Drink heals **1d8 HP**. The party that takes the last Drink finds a **Desert Rose Crystal** worth **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The Fleeting Oasis vanishes at the end of Round 5.

**16. Abandoned Smuggler's Sandcrawler.**
**Setup:** Place a "Broken Sandcrawler" (2"×4" **Impassable Terrain**).
**Interact [2 AP]:** Make an **INT Check** to search interior.
**Reward:** The cache yields **1 Treasure roll** and a **Sand-Proof Cloak** scenario reward item. The wearer ignores Sandstorm and other sand-based weather penalties for the rest of the adventure.
**Special Rules:** When the cache is opened, roll **1d4**. On a **1**, place **1d2 Giant Scorpions** inside the cache area, using the canonical bestiary entry. The placed combatants are **Awake** and hostile.

**17. Glyph of the Burning Sun.**
**Setup:** Large glyph (1" marker).
**Interact [2 AP]:** A Hero within **2"** and **LOS** may make an **INT Check** to neutralize the glyph.
**Reward:** Neutralizing the glyph grants **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The first combatant to move within **1"** of the glyph triggers an **Aura 3"** burst centred on the glyph. Each combatant in the area makes a **DEX Check**. On a failure, they suffer **1d10 fire damage** and become **Weakened**. The glyph is then spent.

**18. Thirsting Wind Predator's Emergence.**
**Setup:** None.
**Reward:** Defeating the Wind Predator yields their **CV** plus a **Core of Bound Wind** worth **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. The Core may instead be consumed once during this adventure to grant **+3" Speed** for one **Move**.
**Special Rules:** The first time a Hero drinks from a Waterskin or Oasis, place **1 Imp** if **APL** is **1–2**, or **1 Wind Elemental** if **APL** is **3+**, within **6"** of that Hero, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Wind Predator is **Awake** and hostile.

**19. Treasure Map Piece (Desert Ruin).**
**Setup:** One pre-designated Treasure Chest contains a "Map Piece".
**Reward:** The Map Piece is worth **5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. In campaign play, a party that has collected **2** Map Pieces may sell the completed map during the **Town Phase** for an additional **10 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, using the APL of the adventure in which the second Piece was found. Both Pieces are then expended.
**Special Rules:** The Map Piece is collected when the Treasure Chest is opened.

**20. The Solar Reflector Array.**
**Setup:** Place a corroded **Bronze Reflector** at the battlefield centre and a **Sealed Vault** token **12"** from it, with an unobstructed line between their centres.
**Interact [2 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Bronze Reflector angles it to focus the harsh sun, making a **DEX Check**.
**Success:** A **1"-wide** beam projects in a straight line, chosen by that Hero, up to **12"** from the Reflector. Every combatant the beam crosses suffers **1d6 fire damage**, or half after a successful **DEX Check**. If the beam reaches the Sealed Vault, its lock melts open.
**Failure:** The brittle mechanism jams for the rest of that activation and projects no beam.
**Reward:** The first party to open the Sealed Vault with the beam claims its contents, worth **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.

#### Climate 6: The Mire Secondary Objectives (1d20)

**1. Leech-Infested Shallows.**
**Setup:** Designate a **3"×3"** **Shallow Water** area.
**Trigger:** The first Hero that enters the area or ends an activation there gains **1d3** attached Swamp Leeches.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero may remove one attached Swamp Leech from themselves or an adjacent ally.
**Special Rules:** Each attached Swamp Leech makes that Hero lose **1 HP** at the start of their activation.
**Reward:** A removed Swamp Leech may be kept as an alchemical reagent. The first party to collect **2** Swamp Leeches gains **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.

**2. Sunken Idol of the Bog Father.**
**Setup:** Place an **Idol** marker in **Deep Water**, adjacent to the bank.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Idol may make a **STR Check** to retrieve it.
**Success:** The Hero retrieves the Idol as a carried objective worth **6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** and finds **1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Failure:** Place **1d2 Lizardfolk Warriors** within **2"** of the Idol, using the canonical bestiary entry. The placed combatants are **Awake** and hostile. The Idol can still be attempted.

**3. Will-o'-Wisp's False Light.**
**Setup:** Place one **Will-o'-Wisp** at one battlefield edge, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Will-o'-Wisp begins **Awake**. Place a "Flickering Light" illusion marker on the opposite side.
**Reward:** The Will-o'-Wisp drops **Corpse-Light Essence**, a scenario reward item. Once during this adventure, a Hero may spend **[1 AP]** to use it against one target within **6"**. The target must pass a **SPI Check** or become **Frightened**. The Will-o'-Wisp also yields their **CV**. The party that defeats them gains **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** for dispelling the trick.
**Special Rules:** The Will-o'-Wisp moves toward the Flickering Light marker during their activation. They attack if a Hero is within **4"** of the Flickering Light marker.

**4. Bubbling Tar Pit.**
**Setup:** Place a "Tar Pit" (**2"×2" Difficult Terrain**) with a "Fossilized Bone" in the centre.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Fossilized Bone may retrieve it.
**Reward:** The Fossilized Bone is worth **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** A combatant that enters the Tar Pit or starts their activation in it becomes **Immobilized** and suffers **1d4 fire damage**. An **Immobilized** combatant in the Tar Pit may spend **1 AP** and pass a **STR Check** to remove **Immobilized** and move to the nearest legal space outside the Tar Pit.

**5. Grasping Mangrove Thicket Maze.**
**Setup:** Place a **4"×6"** Mangrove Maze as **Difficult Terrain**. Place a Lost Explorer's Pack marker inside the maze.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Lost Explorer's Pack may retrieve it.
**Reward:** The pack contains **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** and a **Bog Compass** scenario reward item. Once during this adventure, the bearer may gain **Advantage** on one **INT Check** made to avoid a hazard, identify a false trail, or choose a safe route.
**Special Rules:** For each **2"** a combatant moves through the maze, they must make a **DEX Check**. On a failure, they become **Immobilized**. The **Immobilized** combatant, or a combatant adjacent to them, may cut the roots as an **Interact [1 AP]** action; the **Immobilized** combatant then suffers **1 piercing damage** and removes **Immobilized**.

**6. Abandoned Witch's Hut.**
**Setup:** Place a "Hut" (2"×2").
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make an **INT Check** to search.
**Success:** The Hero finds **1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** and **1d2** "Strange Potions". Roll **1d6** for each potion: **1–2:** restore **1d6 HP**; **3:** deal **1d4 poison damage** when drunk; **4:** gain **+1" Speed** until the end of the round; **5:** become **Weakened**; **6:** create an **Aura 2"** area of smoke that provides **Cover** until the end of the round.
**Failure:** Place **1d3 Stirges** adjacent to the Hero, using the canonical bestiary entry. They are **Awake** and hostile. Their **Blood Drain** also inflicts **Poisoned [d4]** on a target that suffers damage from them.

**7. Curse of the Drowned Spirit.**
**Setup:** Designate one **Shallow Water** body, then place a Sacred Reed Bundle marker within **3"** of it.
**Interact [1 AP]:** An ally adjacent to the cursed Hero and carrying the Sacred Reed Bundle may make a **SPI Check** to lift the curse.
**Success:** Remove the curse.
**Failure:** The curse remains active.
**Reward:** If the curse is lifted and the cursed Hero survives the adventure, that Hero's party gains **5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The first Hero who suffers a **Wound** in this water becomes **Cursed**. A Hero adjacent to the Sacred Reed Bundle marker may use **Interact [1 AP]** and make an **INT Check** to find it; on a success, they pick it up as a carried objective.

**8. Crocodile's Guarded Nest.**
**Setup:** Place a **Sandy Bank** marker (**2"×2"**) with "Crocodile Eggs" guarded by one **Crocodile** if **APL** is **1–3**, or **2 Crocodiles** if **APL** is **4+**, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Crocodiles begin **Resting**.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Claim the Crocodile Eggs.
**Reward:** The Crocodile Eggs are worth **6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** Each Crocodile becomes **Awake** if a Hero moves within **3"** of them or attacks them.

**9. Sinking Ruins Fragment.**
**Setup:** Place a **Ruin Fragment** marker (1"×2") in swamp water. It sinks at the end of Round 3.
**Interact [2 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Ruin Fragment makes a **STR Check**. When a total of **2** successful **Checks** have been made across both parties, the Sealed Chest is pulled free; the party that made the second successful **Check** retrieves it. After the Fragment sinks, it can no longer be Interacted with.
**Reward:** The Chest yields **1 Treasure roll**.

**10. Lizardfolk Offering Pole.**
**Setup:** A crude pole (1").
**Interact [1 AP]:** Choose one option: take the Offering or leave an Offering. If the Hero takes the Offering, that party gains **1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, and the Hero suffers **Disadvantage** on their next **SPI Check** against an effect that causes **Frightened**. If the Hero leaves an Offering, that party pays **1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, to a minimum of **1c**, and the Hero gains **1 Luck Point**.
**Special Rules:** Each party may resolve this objective once.

**11. Bloated Corpse Discovery.**
**Setup:** "Bloated Corpse" floats in water.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make a **STR Check** to drag the corpse ashore and search it. After the **Check** resolves, roll **1d6**. On a **1–3**, the corpse explodes; Heroes within **1"** must pass a **STR Check** or become **Poisoned [d4]**.
**Reward:** The corpse contains **1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The corpse drifts away at the start of Round 4.

**12. Sudden Marsh Fever Outbreak.**
**Setup:** At the start of Round 3, place 2 Feverwort markers in shallow water or swamp terrain, each at least **6"** from any deployment edge.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to a Feverwort marker may make an **INT Check** or **SPI Check** to prepare an antidote.
**Reward:** Success removes Marsh Fever from one allied Hero and grants that party **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. Each Feverwort marker can be used once.
**Special Rules:** At the start of Round 3, each Hero makes a **STR Check**. On a failure, that Hero contracts "Marsh Fever": they suffer **Disadvantage** on **STR Checks** and **DEX Checks** until the end of the adventure.

**13. Hag's Misleading Trail.**
**Setup:** Place a trail of **3** Fetish markers leading to a fake treasure marker.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to a Fetish marker may make an **INT Check** to identify the false trail.
**Success:** The Hero identifies the trail as false. A party that avoids the trail completely after succeeding on the first Fetish marker's **INT Check** gains **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Failure:** No effect.
**Special Rules:** The first time a Hero reaches the end of the trail, remove the fake treasure marker and place a number of **Boglings** whose total **LVL** is no greater than half **APL**, minimum **1**, maximum **4**. Place them within **2"** of that Hero, using the canonical bestiary entry. The placed Monsters are **Awake** and roll the base damage dice of their first attack with **Advantage**.

**14. Sunken Relic Chest.**
**Setup:** Place a Sunken Relic Chest marker in **Deep Water**.
**Interact [2 AP]:** A Hero adjacent to the Sunken Relic Chest may make a **DEX Check** to retrieve it.
**Success:** The Hero retrieves the Sunken Relic Chest.
**Failure:** The Chest remains in place.
**Reward:** The Chest yields **1 Treasure roll** and one roll on the **Tier 1 Scrolls** (**1d2**: **1** = Arcane, **2** = Divine), sealed in a waterproof case.

**15. Territorial Lizardfolk Warrior.**
**Setup:** Place **1 Lizardfolk Warrior** guarding a **4"×4"** lily pad patch, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Lizardfolk Warrior begins **Awake**.
**Trigger:** The Lizardfolk Warrior attacks any combatant that enters the lily pad patch.
**Reward:** Defeating the Lizardfolk Warrior allows a Hero adjacent to the lily pad patch to claim **Golden Lily Pollen** with **Interact [1 AP]**. It is worth **5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, or may be consumed once during this adventure to heal **1d8 HP**.

**16. Whispering Willows of Despair.**
**Setup:** 3"×3" "Willows" (**Cover Terrain**, **Natural**).
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make an **INT Check** to search the willows.
**Success:** The Hero gains the "Lost Soul Locket," worth **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Failure:** The Hero suffers **Disadvantage** on their next damage roll and cannot be healed until the end of the round.
**Special Rules:** A Hero that enters the Willows or ends their activation within them makes a **SPI Check**. On a failure, that Hero suffers **1 psychic damage**. On a natural **1**, that Hero instead becomes **Sleeping** as the willows whisper them under.

**17. Glyph of a Thousand Bites.**
**Setup:** Place a Glyph marker in **Shallow Water**.
**Interact [1 AP]:** A Hero within **2"** and **LOS** may make an **INT Check** to neutralize the glyph.
**Reward:** Neutralizing the glyph grants **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Special Rules:** The first combatant to move within **1"** of the glyph triggers spectral piranhas. That combatant suffers **1d8 piercing damage per APL**, to a maximum of **4d8**. The glyph is then spent.

**18. Marsh Gas Seep and Ignition.**
**Setup:** Place three Gas Seep markers, each **1"** across, with **HP 1** and **AV 0**. They may be targeted by attacks.
**Trigger:** A Gas Seep ignites when a **Burning** combatant, a lit **Torch**, or a lit **Lantern** moves within **2"** of it, or when the Gas Seep takes damage.
**Special Rules:** When a Gas Seep ignites, remove its marker, then resolve its explosion in **Aura 2"** centred on the marker's former position. Each combatant in the Aura suffers **1d8 fire damage**, or half that damage after a successful **DEX Check**.
**Reward:** The first party to ignite one Gas Seep finds **Fired-Amber** worth **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.

**19. Ancient Crocodile's Hoard.**
**Setup:** Place a **Nest** marker (1") at the edge of a **Deep Water** area. Place one **Crocodile** in that **Deep Water**, within **3"** of the Nest, using the canonical bestiary entry. The Crocodile begins **Hidden** and does not lose **Hidden** for lacking **Cover** while they remain in **Deep Water**.
**Interact [1 AP]:** Make an **INT Check** to search the nest.
**Success:** The Hero gains **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** and one mundane weapon.
**Reward:** Defeating the Crocodile allows the nest to be searched safely.
**Special Rules:** The Crocodile attacks any Hero that enters that **Deep Water** area or that ends a second consecutive activation within **2"** of the Nest.

**20. Bog Beacon's Curse/Boon.**
**Setup:** "Bog Beacon" (1") on an island.
**Interact [2 AP]:** Make a **SPI Check**.
**Success:** The Hero gains one Swamp Boon, choosing one: ignore water terrain movement costs until the end of the next round, become **Resistant** to poison damage until the end of the adventure, or heal **2d6 HP**. That party also gains **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
**Failure:** The Hero has **Disadvantage** on their next damage roll.
**Critical Failure (natural 1):** The Hero becomes **Poisoned [d4]**. Then randomly select an eligible encounter from the applicable Mire Random Monster Table whose total **LVL** is no greater than half **APL**, rounded down to a minimum of **1**. If none is eligible, use **1 Bogling** instead. Place the hostile Group within **4"** of that Hero; it is **Awake**.
**Special Rules:** This objective can be resolved once per adventure.

### 10.3 Weather Tables by Climate

If the Core Scenario or a rolled Secondary Objective does not specify the weather conditions, roll 1d6 on the Weather Table appropriate to the current adventure's Climate during Step 5 of the Adventure Preparation Sequence.

The rolled weather effect persists for the entire adventure unless a Special Rule, another game effect, or a subsequent weather roll explicitly changes it. A **Weather Shift** Power suppresses this persistent result temporarily without replacing it, as described in **8.2**.

After weather is rolled, determine the battlefield's **Visibility State**. If a weather result does not specify **Darkness**, the battlefield starts in **Light**. A weather result may set the battlefield to **Darkness** only if it explicitly says so, such as night, moonless night, underground darkness, supernatural eclipse, blizzard darkness, ashfall darkness, or another specific visibility effect.

Every Weather Table uses the same severity shape. Result **1** is severe, results **2–3** are moderate, results **4–5** are minor, and result **6** applies no adverse effect. No weather result reduces **LOS** below **6"**.

#### Climate 1: Greenmark Weather Table

| 1d6 | Weather Condition | Effect |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | Blackwater Deluge | **LOS** is reduced to 6". Every area of **Open Terrain** and **Cover Terrain** that is not explicitly "Indoors" or "Rocky" becomes **Difficult Terrain**; **Impassable Terrain** and **Blocking Terrain** are unchanged. At the end of their activation, each combatant that is not in **Cover** must pass a **STR Check** or suffer **1 HP loss**. |
| 2 | Heavy Rain and Mud | Every area of **Open Terrain** and **Cover Terrain** that is not explicitly "Indoors" or "Rocky" becomes **Difficult Terrain**; **Impassable Terrain** and **Blocking Terrain** are unchanged. Ranged attacks targeting beyond 10" roll their base damage dice with **Disadvantage**. |
| 3 | Thick Morning Fog | The battlefield starts in **Light**. Fog covers the battlefield and provides **Cover** in every space. |
| 4 | Strong Gusting Winds | All ranged weapon attacks suffer a -1 penalty to their final damage total. Powers are unaffected. Combatants using **Fly (X")** movement from any source treat all air as **Difficult Terrain**. At the end of each round, roll **1d6** for each such combatant that is not on a surface. On a **1–3**, **Slide** them **1"** using **Random Direction** in **10.1**. |
| 5 | Intermittent Showers | At the start of each round, roll 1d6. On a 1–2, the Heavy Rain and Mud effects apply for this round. On a 3–6, no adverse weather effect applies this round. |
| 6 | Dappled Sunlight | Shifting light and shade play across the forest floor. No adverse weather effects apply. Standard conditions apply. |

#### Climate 2: Ashlands Weather Table

| 1d6 | Weather Condition | Effect |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | Ashfall Blackout | The battlefield's **Visibility State** is **Darkness**. Every area of **Open Terrain** and **Cover Terrain** becomes **Difficult Terrain**; **Impassable Terrain** and **Blocking Terrain** are unchanged. At the end of their activation, each combatant that is not in **Cover** suffers **1 HP loss** as ash fills their lungs. |
| 2 | Dust Haze | Targets more than 10" away have **Cover** (ranged attacks targeting them roll their base damage dice with **Disadvantage**). At the end of each round, each Hero that is not in **Cover** must pass a **STR Check** or suffer **1 HP loss**. |
| 3 | Blistering Sun | At the end of their activation, a Hero that spent **2 AP** or more on **Move** actions or took an **Attack** action during that activation suffers **1 fire damage** from heat exhaustion, unless they declare the use of a Waterskin (1 use negates this effect for the rest of the adventure). |
| 4 | Unsettling Stillness | All combatants roll **Spot Checks** and any **Interact Check** whose rule explicitly states that it relies on speech, sound, or hearing with **Disadvantage**. |
| 5 | Sudden Sand Gusts | At the start of each Monster Phase, roll 1d6. On a 1–2, a strong gust sweeps the battlefield. **Slide** one random Hero from each party **1"** using **Random Direction** in **10.1**; each becomes **Blinded** unless they pass a **STR Check**. |
| 6 | Clear Skies, Hot Air | No adverse weather effects apply, but the ambient heat is notable (carrying Waterskins remains specified by the scenario). |

#### Climate 3: Undermarches Cavern Conditions Table

Subterranean adventures replace the standard Weather roll with an ambient Cavern Condition, generated using the same process and timing. If a Core Scenario's own terrain rules set the battlefield's lighting or **Visibility State**, those scenario rules take priority over the rolled Cavern Condition's lighting; apply the Cavern Condition's other effects normally.

| 1d6 | Cavern Condition | Effect |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | Deep Gloom and Condensation | The battlefield's **Visibility State** is **Darkness**. Ranged attacks targeting beyond **6"** roll their base damage dice with **Disadvantage** unless the attacker ignores visual penalties caused by **Darkness** at that distance. The extreme dampness affects equipment: Heroes and Hirelings wearing non-metal Chest armour suffer **-1** on that armour's **AD** rolls, and **Monsters** with **AV 1** or higher suffer **-1 AV**. |
| 2 | Quiet, Still, and Dark | The battlefield's **Visibility State** is **Darkness**. No other ambient condition applies. |
| 3 | Disorienting Echoes | Double the listed range of any attack, Power, or Special Ability whose rules text says it relies on sound, a roar, a scream, a wail, or a shout. When a Hero or Hireling uses such an attack, Power, or Special Ability, or uses a Special Ability that explicitly requires speech, chanting, or invocation, every **Resting** Monster Group within **12"** of them immediately becomes **Awake**. |
| 4 | Minor Cave Tremors | Divide the battlefield into four equal 18"×18" quadrants and number them before Round 1. At the end of each round, roll **1d4** to determine one quadrant. Each combatant in that quadrant must make a **DEX Check**. On a failure, **Slide** that combatant **1"** using **Random Direction** in **10.1**. |
| 5 | Stagnant, Foul Air | Any Hero that spends **3 AP or more** on actions during one activation must make a **STR Check** at the end of that activation or become **Weakened** until the end of the round. **0 AP** actions do not count toward this total. |
| 6 | Phosphorescent Bloom | Glowing fungi coat the walls and ceiling. The battlefield's **Visibility State** is **Light**. No other ambient condition applies. |

Each combatant suffers **1 ice damage** at the end of their activation if they are not in **Cover** or wearing **Arctic Gear**. |

Roll **1d2**: on **1**, the bank follows the North-South axis; on **2**, the bank follows the East-West axis, using the battlefield orientation designated under **Random Direction** in **10.1**. The area within provides **Cover**, and combatants ending their activation inside suffer **1 ice damage**. |
| 4 | Biting Wind Chill | All combatants have a **-1"** penalty to Speed. When a combatant becomes **Prone** on an icy surface because they were **Pushed**, **Slide** them an additional **1"** in the direction of that **Push**. When a combatant becomes **Prone** there because they fell, **Slide** them **1"** directly away from the fall origin when viewed from above; if the origin is directly above them, use **Random Direction** in **10.1**. |
| 5 | Rime Ice Accumulation | All terrain features gain a slick layer of rime ice. **STR Checks** to **Climb** are made with **Disadvantage**. Any Hero knocked **Prone** also becomes **Slowed** as the ice clings to them. |
| 6 | Clear Polar Sky | The wind drops and the sky clears to a hard pale blue. No adverse weather effects apply. |

Each combatant not in **Cover** suffers **1 piercing damage** at the end of their activation. **AV** and **AD** do not apply. |

In all subsequent rounds, at the end of their activation, a Hero that spent **2 AP** or more on **Move** actions or made an **Attack** action during that activation loses **1 HP** from exhaustion, unless they declare the use of a Waterskin; 1 use negates this effect for the rest of the adventure. |

A strong gust sweeps a **6"** wide line spanning the full battlefield, centred on the battlefield centre and running perpendicular to the rolled direction. **Slide** each combatant in the line **1d3"** in the rolled direction; each becomes **Blinded** unless they pass a **STR Check**. |
| 4 | Shimmering Heat Mirage | Visual distortion ruins aim. Ranged attacks made at targets more than 10" away treat the target as having **Cover** (their base damage dice roll with **Disadvantage**). |

### 10.4 Core Scenario Outlines

The following section details **36 Core Scenarios**, with **6 scenarios for each of the 6 Climates**. Before starting an adventure, parties determine the Climate and then select or randomly roll one of that Climate's Core Scenarios. Generate a Secondary Objective and a Weather result for the chosen Climate as normal unless the scenario says otherwise.

**[Intro]** marks the recommended first full-rules scenario for that Climate. The tag has no rules effect.

Every scenario uses the dynamic scaling rules in **10.6 Dynamic Party and Scenario Scaling** unless its entry gives a specific override.

If a scenario's **Victory Conditions** name no winner for an outcome, the party with the most total Coin Value wins. If that comparison is tied, use the scenario's printed **Tiebreaker**.

If a scenario's printed Tiebreaker is also tied, the adventure is a draw: neither party wins the adventure, and both parties keep their banked Coins and earned rewards.

#### Climate 1: Greenmark Scenarios

##### Scenario 1: Hunt the Wild Beast [Intro]

*Something out of the deep wood has taken Greythorn's logging camps for their hunting ground, and with them the timber the Bastion is built on. The first deaths were blamed on dire wolves. The next were found driven through splintered palisade timbers, which dire wolves do not manage. Their pelt, skull, and teeth would buy a season behind the walls, and the Council of Captains will pay either way to have the camps cutting again. Comfort and timber have sent both parties into the trees.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the party that escapes with the Pristine Boar Pelt.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Defeat the Great Forest Boar, harvest the Pristine Boar Pelt, then extract the Pelt and at least 1 Hero through any battlefield edge.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Dense forest with several Game Trails (clear paths, 1–2" wide). Place 5–7 Tree area terrain pieces and 3–4 Thickets. Place one **Mud Wallow** marker (2"×2") near the centre of the battlefield.

**Objective Placement:** The Great Forest Boar starts within 2" of the Mud Wallow. When the Boar is defeated, place a **Pristine Boar Pelt** token where they fell. Place 3 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) along game trails, at least 6" apart.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Great Forest Boar**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (4 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 1 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 7" | APL + 1 (min 3, max 7) | 0c | L |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize the valid enemy that most recently dealt damage to the Boar. If that enemy is not a valid target, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Gore:** 1d10 + APL piercing damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Ferocious Charge:** If the Boar moves at least 4" in a straight line before making a Gore attack in the same activation, that Gore deals an additional **1d6 damage of that attack's primary damage type**.
- **Trample:** At the start of their activation, if the Boar is not **Engaged** and has a **Primary Target**, they move up to their full Speed in a straight line toward that target, stopping at the last legal position. The Boar may move through enemy spaces during this movement but cannot end overlapping a combatant. Every enemy whose space the Boar passes through suffers **1d8 + APL/2 blunt damage**. Each combatant that takes damage also falls **Prone**.
- **Enraged Bellow:** When the Boar is first reduced to 25% or less of their Max HP, at the start of their next activation they Bellow. All **Resting** Monster Groups on the battlefield immediately become **Awake**. During that activation, the Boar makes their Trample as normal, except the straight line's direction is determined by a **1d8** random-direction roll instead of the Boar's normal AI, and their Gore attack rolls its base damage dice with **Advantage**.
- **Thick Hide:** Reduce damage from ranged weapon attacks by 2, applied after **AV**.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake**, within **2"** of the Mud Wallow.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within **4"** of a game trail, at least **10"** from the Mud Wallow. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within a Thicket, at least **8"** from any Hero deployment zone. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite long battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Claiming the Pelt:** The Pristine Boar Pelt token is placed where the Boar fell when they are defeated. A Hero adjacent to the Pelt uses **Interact [1 AP]** to pick it up. It is a carried objective worth 5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins if escaped with.

**Escape Conditions:** The Hero carrying the Pristine Boar Pelt must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Pelt is carried off-map, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- The party whose Hero escapes with the Pelt wins and gains the Pelt's Coin Value.
- If the Pelt is not escaped with, the party that dealt the most total damage to the Boar wins and gains a consolation prize of 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins. If both parties dealt identical total damage to the Boar, neither gains the consolation prize and both retain only their Chest and Monster CV totals; the **Tiebreaker** below decides the winner.

Rewards from Treasure Chests and any Monster CV are added to each party's final total regardless of outcome.

**Tiebreaker:** If no party escapes with the Pelt and total Boar damage is also tied, the party with the most total Coin Value from all other sources wins.

##### Scenario 2: The Whispering Grove

*The grove is older than Greythorn and older than the western forest road that skirts it. The standing stones hum when no wind passes, and pale lights move between them on moonless nights. Greythorn's farmers leave bread there and do not look back. Scholars call it a site of power. The Council of Captains calls it part of the tithe, and pays it without complaint.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the party that has successfully activated the most Standing Stones by the end of Round 7.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Standing Stones. A majority is more than half the number placed.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Activate a majority of the Standing Stones placed after scaling, then extract at least 1 Hero through any battlefield edge.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place 3–5 Tree area terrain pieces and 6–7 Undergrowth patches around the battlefield edges, leaving a Central Clearing (about 12–15" diameter) at the battlefield's centre. Within the Clearing, place 3 **Standing Stone** markers (1"×1") in a rough triangle, each 6–8" apart.

**Objective Placement:** The 3 Standing Stones are the Primary Objectives. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) within dense forest sections near different battlefield edges, at least 8" from any Stone.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Antlered Warden**

*Not Old Wode themselves. Old Wode does not stir for small intrusions. The Antlered Warden is the agreement's enforcement arm: a figure woven from the grove's oldest growth, robed in bark and grey moss, with antlers that have more branches than any natural animal. They do not speak. They do not negotiate. They maintain the terms.*

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (2 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 1 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 6" (ignores forest **Difficult Terrain**) | APL (min 2, max 5) | (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | L |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize the valid Hero who most recently activated or attempted to activate a Standing Stone. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

1. **Entangling Roots:** If the **Primary Target** is within **8"** and is not **Immobilized**, that enemy becomes **Immobilized**. Then end this activation.

**Attacks**
  - **Thorny Vine Lash:** **Reach**, 1d6 + APL/2 slashing damage.
  - **Mystic Bolt:** 1d4 + APL psychic damage, **Ranged 10"**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Fey Resistance:** This Monster is **Resistant** to **arcane** damage, and is **Immune** to **Frightened** and **Sleeping**.

**Boss Deployment:** Not yet placed at setup. When a Hero first Interacts with a Standing Stone, place the Antlered Warden adjacent to that Stone. The Antlered Warden is **Awake** when placed.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within **3"** of one outer Standing Stone. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place inside the Central Clearing, **4"** from its edge. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within **3"** of one Treasure Chest. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties make a Setup Roll-off. The winner chooses an 8"×8" corner zone. The other party deploys in the diagonally opposite corner.

**Special Rules:**

**Activating a Standing Stone:** A Hero adjacent to a Standing Stone uses **Interact [2 AP]** and makes a **SPI Check**. On a success, that party claims the stone; mark it with a token. A stone may be claimed by only one party. Once claimed, it cannot be reclaimed. Each claimed stone is worth 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins at the adventure's end.

**Grove's Boon:** Each time a Hero successfully activates a Standing Stone, that Hero immediately chooses one: heal 1d6 HP, or regain 1d4 NRG. This boon applies only to the activating Hero.

**Wild Magic Flux:** Each time a Hero casts a Power within **6"** of any Standing Stone, the caster rolls **1d6** after paying the Power's costs and before any **Reaction** to that Power is declared. On a **1**, roll **1d3**: **1:** the caster loses **1d4 HP**; **2:** the Power targets a random valid combatant within **3"** of the original target instead; **3:** increase the Power's NRG cost by **1** for this casting. If the caster cannot pay the increased cost, the Power still resolves, and the caster is reduced to **0 NRG**.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends immediately when one party claims a majority of the Standing Stones placed after scaling, after Round 7, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party with the most claimed Standing Stones wins.

**Tiebreaker:** The party with the most total Coin Value wins.

##### Scenario 3: The Bandit's Toll

*The western forest road carries Deepwarden iron, Reedmarch salt, and grain between the Bastions, and it is the one artery Greythorn cannot do without. A toll crew has claimed a bend of the trail and nailed its prices to the trees in stolen blood. Caravans wait behind palisades while bread grows dear inside Greythorn's walls. The Council of Captains has stamped a bounty and sent it out with anyone hungry enough to answer.*

**Primary Objective:** Defeat the Toll Captain and bank more total Coin Value than the opposing party.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Stolen Wagons. The required number of looted Wagons is half the number placed, rounded up.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Defeat the Toll Captain, loot at least half of the Stolen Wagons placed after scaling, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** A "Trail" (clear path, about 3–4" wide) runs the full length of the battlefield from one short edge to the other. Place 6–8 Tree area terrain pieces and 3–4 Undergrowth area terrain pieces on either side of the Trail. Place one "Makeshift Barricade" (2–3" long, HP 15, AV 2 per 1" section) across the Trail at the battlefield's midpoint.

**Objective Placement:** Determine the number of Stolen Wagons after scaling; the printed number is **3**. Each Wagon is a Treasure Chest marker yielding **1 Treasure roll**.

- If 1 Wagon is placed, place **Wagon 2** only.
- If 2 Wagons are placed, place **Wagon 2** and randomly determine whether to place **Wagon 1** or **Wagon 3**.
- If 3 Wagons are placed, place all 3 Wagons.

Place each included Wagon as follows:

- **Wagon 1:** On the Trail, 8" from one short battlefield edge.
- **Wagon 2:** On the Trail, adjacent to the central Barricade.
- **Wagon 3:** On the Trail, 8" from the opposite short battlefield edge.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Toll Captain**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (3 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 5" | APL (min 2, max 6) | 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**Attacks**
  - **Scimitar:** 1d8 + APL/2 slashing damage.
  - **Shortbow:** 1d6 + APL/2 piercing damage, **Ranged 12"**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Command Raiders:** At the start of the Captain's activation, choose one allied **Bandit** within 6". That **Bandit** immediately **Shifts 1"** and makes one attack. That attack rolls its base damage dice with **Disadvantage**. Then the Captain's activation continues.
- **Parry:** This defence is a Special Ability, not a Reaction, and costs nothing. Each time a melee attack targets the Captain, the Captain parries with their Scimitar. Roll **1d8 + APL/2** as the Captain's parry roll and compare it to the attack as described in the core **Parry** rules. The Captain does not Riposte.
- **Take Hostage:** When the Captain is at 25% or less of their Max HP and is **Engaged** with a Hero while also within 1" of a Stolen Wagon, they seize the wagon. The Wagon cannot be looted while the Captain remains adjacent to it and this ability is active. The Captain gains **+1 AV** while this ability is active. This ability ends if the Captain moves more than 1" from that Wagon or rises above 25% of their Max HP.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake**, behind the central Barricade, within **1"** of Wagon 2.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Bandits (×APL/2, rounded up). Place within **3"** of Wagon 1's printed position, whether or not Wagon 1 is placed, and not on the Trail. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Bandits (×APL/2, rounded up). Place within **3"** of Wagon 3's printed position, whether or not Wagon 3 is placed, and not on the Trail. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place in cover at least 8" from any Wagon and 8" from any Hero deployment zone. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties make a Setup Roll-off. The winner chooses one short battlefield edge (where the Trail enters). They deploy their party within **6"** of that edge with at least two Heroes, or their only Hero, starting on the Trail. The other party deploys within **6"** of the opposite short battlefield edge under the same conditions.

**Special Rules:**

**The Barricade:** **Impassable Terrain**. A combatant may **Climb** over it as **1"** of vertical movement, or attack it (HP 15, AV 2 per 1" section). A section of Barricade reduced to **0 HP** is removed.

**Bandit Reinforcements:** At the end of Round 3, if the Toll Captain is still alive and above half their Max HP, Bandits (×APL/2, rounded up) enter from the midpoint of the battlefield edge closest to the Toll Captain. If two or more edges are equidistant, the party that lost the Setup Roll-off chooses among them. They are placed touching that edge and are **Awake**.

**Looting Wagons:** A Hero adjacent to a Wagon uses **Interact [1 AP]** to loot it, gaining its Coin Value immediately. A Wagon guarded by the Captain's Take Hostage ability cannot be looted.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends after Round 8, or immediately when the Toll Captain has been defeated and at least half of the Stolen Wagons placed after scaling, rounded up, have been looted in total across both parties, whichever comes first.

- The party with the most total Coin Value, counting rewards from looted Wagons, Monster CV, and Secondary Objective Coins, wins.
- A party that both defeated the Toll Captain and looted at least half of the Stolen Wagons placed after scaling, rounded up, adds a **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** Trade Route bonus to its total before the winner is determined.

**Tiebreaker:** If both parties have identical Coin totals, the party that dealt the killing blow to the Toll Captain wins.

##### Scenario 4: The Spider's Silk Route

*Silk-traders whisper of a ravine in the deep Greenmark where the webs hold steel like thread and fetch absurd prices in Bastion markets. The spinners are the Broodmother's daughters, strayed up from the dark, and the place is on no honest map. That has not stopped a Greythorn merchant from selling the same path through the thorns to two parties at once.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the party to escape with the highest Coin Value from harvested Spider Silk Bundles.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Spider Silk Bundles.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Harvest and extract at least half of the Spider Silk Bundles placed after scaling, rounded up, then extract at least half the party as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** A Ravine (6–8" wide, 2" deep) runs across the battlefield perpendicular to the long edges, dividing it at the midpoint. The Ravine floor is **Difficult Terrain**. Place 5–7 **Webbed Section** markers (2–3" diameter, **Difficult Terrain**) within and at the edges of the Ravine, including one at its centre. Place 4–6 Tree area terrain pieces along the ravine edges on higher ground.

**Objective Placement:** Determine the number of **Spider Silk Bundles** using **10.6.9**; the printed number is **3**. Place them inside different Webbed Sections within the Ravine, at least **4"** apart. Place the first Bundle in the central Webbed Section; it is the **central Silk Bundle**. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) on higher ground overlooking the Ravine, at least 8" from any battlefield edge.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Broodmother Spider**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (5 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 6" (Climb 6") | APL + 2 (min 4, max 8) | 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | L |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize valid Heroes who are harvesting a Silk Bundle or attacking an accompanying Giant Tarantula. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Venomous Fangs:** 1d10 + APL/2 piercing damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Potent Poison:** A target damaged by **Venomous Fangs** must make a **STR Check**. **Failure:** The target becomes **Poisoned [d6]**.
- **Web Barrage:** At the start of their activation, if their **Primary Target** is within 8" and is not **Immobilized**, the Broodmother targets an **Aura 2"** area centred on that target. Each combatant in the area becomes **Immobilized**. The area becomes a Webbed Section until cleared under **Flammable Webs**.
- **Web Walker:** The Broodmother ignores all movement penalties and **Immobilized** effects from Webbed Sections.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** at the centre of the Ravine, within 1" of the central Silk Bundle. Accompanied by 2 Giant Tarantulas (**Awake**) within 2" of the Broodmother. An additional 2 Giant Tarantulas start **Resting** in a Webbed Section near a second Silk Bundle. If only one Bundle is placed, use the Webbed Section farthest from the central Bundle.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place on high ground overlooking the Ravine. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite short battlefield edges, on higher ground outside the Ravine, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Webbed Sections, Movement Penalty:** A combatant entering or ending their activation in a Webbed Section makes a **DEX Check**. **Failure:** That combatant becomes **Immobilized**. A combatant **Immobilized** by a Webbed Section, or an adjacent ally, may use **Interact [1 AP]** and make a **STR Check** or **DEX Check** to cut them free. On a success, remove **Immobilized** and place the freed combatant in the nearest legal space outside that Webbed Section.

**Harvesting Silk:** A Hero adjacent to a Silk Bundle uses **Interact [2 AP]** and makes an **INT Check**.

- **Success:** The Hero collects the Bundle as a carried objective, worth 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins if escaped with.
- **Failure:** The Bundle is damaged. If later escaped with, it is worth 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins instead.
- **Critical Failure (natural 1):** The Bundle is ruined and removed from play.

**Ruined Bundles:** A ruined Bundle token is removed from play and is not a valid carried or claimed objective.

**Flammable Webs:** Any Webbed Section that takes fire damage is cleared; remove the marker. Combatants inside the section when it ignites suffer **1d4 fire damage**.

**Escape Conditions:** Heroes carrying Silk Bundles must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends after Round 8, when every Silk Bundle has been escaped with or ruined, when all surviving Heroes from at least one party have escaped, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party that escapes with the highest Coin Value from secured (undamaged or damaged) Silk Bundles wins. The party whose Hero deals the killing blow to the Broodmother gains an additional **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.

**Tiebreaker:** The party with the most total Coins from all sources wins.

##### Scenario 5: The Ambushed Emissary

*An emissary vanished on the western forest road carrying documents sealed under two rival Bastion laws. One patron in Greythorn wants the courier found breathing. Another, further off, wants the satchel and does not ask after the courier. The deep wood has kept worse secrets, and the Hollow Quarter is not telling.*

**Primary Objective:** Retrieve the Diplomatic Satchel and escape the battlefield with it.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Clue markers. The Bandit Camp is found when more than half the placed Clues have been deciphered.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Decipher a majority of the Clues placed after scaling, then extract the living Emissary or the dropped Diplomatic Satchel and at least half the party as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Dense forest with small clearings. Place 4–6 Tree area terrain pieces and 2–3 Undergrowth patches. Place one **Makeshift Bandit Camp** marker (about 4"×4", **Cover Terrain**) in one quadrant, at least 8" from any battlefield edge. The Camp's quadrant is determined by the party that won the Setup Roll-off; that party places the Camp.

**Objective Placement:** The Diplomatic Satchel (carried objective, 6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins to the party that escapes with it) is held by the Emissary NPC and is not placed on the battlefield until the Emissary is placed. Place 4 **Clue** markers (1" tokens) in open areas at least 6" from each other and at least 6" from the Bandit Camp. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) hidden at least 8" from any Clue marker.

**Scenario-Specific NPCs and Monsters:**

*Captured Emissary (NPC):* HP 5 | AV 0 | SPD 4" | Sz M | LVL 0. No attacks. Carries the Diplomatic Satchel. Not placed until the Bandit Camp is found (see Special Rules).

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Forest-Road Reeve**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (2 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/4, rounded down) | 6" | APL (min 2, max 5) | (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize valid Heroes who are Interacting with or escorting the Emissary. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Longsword:** 1d8 + APL/2 slashing damage.
  - **Hand Crossbow:** 1d6 + APL/2 piercing damage, **Ranged 8"**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Brutal Order (once per adventure):** At the start of their activation, each Monster in one allied **Bandit** Group within 6" immediately moves up to their Speed before the Forest-Road Reeve's activation continues.

**Boss Deployment:** The Forest-Road Reeve starts **Awake** in the Bandit Camp; not placed until the Camp is found. The Emissary is placed adjacent to the Forest-Road Reeve when placed.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within **4"** of one Clue marker. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within **4"** of a different Clue marker. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place **6"** from the centre of the Bandit Camp. **Resting**. This group becomes **Awake** when combat occurs within the Camp or within 4" of it.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy in opposite corner zones (8"×8"). Parties alternate placing Heroes within their zone, starting with the party that lost the Setup Roll-off.

**Special Rules:**

**Finding the Emissary, Deciphering Clues:** A Hero adjacent to a Clue marker uses **Interact [1 AP]** and makes an **INT Check**. On a success, that Clue is deciphered; mark it. When more than half of the placed Clues have been deciphered across both parties combined, the Bandit Camp is found: place the Forest-Road Reeve and Emissary miniatures there immediately. The Camp terrain itself is visible from setup; the Clues reveal where within it the prisoner is held. Failed **Checks** do not prevent reattempting on a subsequent activation.

**Emissary, Guarded State:** While the Forest-Road Reeve is within 3" of the Emissary, the Emissary is Guarded and cannot be moved or escorted. If the Emissary becomes Guarded after an escort begins, that escort ends immediately; the Emissary stands in place until Freed and a Hero begins a new escort.

**Emissary, Freed State:** The Emissary becomes Freed if the Forest-Road Reeve is defeated or ends their activation more than 3" from the Emissary. A Hero adjacent to the Freed Emissary uses **Interact [1 AP]** to begin escorting them. An escorted Emissary moves with the escorting Hero, remaining within 2" at all times. If the Hero cannot move, the Emissary does not move.

**Escorting, Contested Control:** If a Hero from the opposing party ends their activation adjacent to the Emissary while the current escort Hero is not adjacent to the Emissary, the opposing Hero may use **Interact [1 AP]** at the start of their next activation to take over as escort. The Emissary follows whichever Hero most recently completed this **Interact**. If the escorting Hero is Defeated, the Emissary stops following them and stands in place until a Hero begins escorting them again.

**Diplomatic Satchel:** While the Emissary is alive, they carry the Satchel. The party currently escorting the Emissary controls the Satchel for all scenario rules. If the Emissary is defeated, the Satchel drops in the Emissary's space. A Hero adjacent to the dropped Satchel uses **Interact [1 AP]** to pick it up.

**Escape Conditions:** An escorted Emissary escapes when the escorting Hero and the Emissary both reach the same battlefield edge. This extracts the Satchel for the escorting party. If the Emissary has been defeated, the Hero carrying the dropped Satchel may escape through any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Satchel is carried off-map, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- The party escaping with the Satchel wins and gains the Satchel's Coin Value.
- If the Emissary escapes the battlefield alive while escorted by one of a party's Heroes, that party gains an additional 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins.
- If neither party secures the Satchel and the Forest-Road Reeve was defeated, the party that dealt the killing blow to the Reeve gains their CV plus a **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** bounty. If neither party secures the Satchel, the party with the most total Coins wins, whether or not the Reeve survives.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 6: Ritual of the Old Growth

*An Old Growth elder works slowly over a sickness in the roots, and a Heartwood Totem worth more than most villages stands at the heart of the rite. Greythorn's tithe forbids touching it, and the Council of Captains keeps the tithe because the alternative is the wild court at the gate. Another Bastion, with no forest to answer to, calls the same act salvage. The roots are listening to both.*

**Role Assignment:** Before deployment, both parties simultaneously and secretly write down **Theft** or **Protection** on a piece of paper, then reveal. A party may freely choose either role. If both parties choose the same role, both may score that role. If both complete it, the party with the higher total escaped Coin Value wins. If still tied, use this scenario's tiebreaker.

**Primary Objective:**

- **Theft:** Secure the Heartwood Totem and escape with it.
- **Protection:** Gain 3 Ward Steps, then ensure the Old Growth Treant completes their ritual with the Treant alive.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Use the **Protection** objective. Gain 3 Ward Steps, keep the Old Growth Treant alive until the ritual reaches step 6, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**. The **Theft** objective is not used.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place a **Mother Tree** marker (3–4" diameter, **Blocking Terrain**) at the battlefield's centre. The area within **6"** of the Mother Tree is the "Sacred Grove", which is **Cover Terrain**, **Natural**, and also **Difficult Terrain** for Heroes without the Druid or Ranger class unless they pass a **SPI Check** upon entering. Place 4–6 Tree area terrain pieces and 2–3 Undergrowth patches on the rest of the battlefield.

**Objective Placement:** The Heartwood Totem (carried objective, 6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins if escaped with) starts adjacent to the Old Growth Treant at the Mother Tree. Place 3 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) at the outer edge of the Sacred Grove, evenly spaced.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Old Growth Treant**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (6 + (2 × APL))) / 2 | 3 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 4" | APL + 3 (min 5, max 9) | 4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | H |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** While **Guardian's Fury** is active, prioritize valid Heroes touching or carrying the Heartwood Totem. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Branch Slam:** **Reach**, 1d10 + APL/2 blunt damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Performing Ritual:** While **Guardian's Fury** is not active, the Treant does not move or attack. They activate but take no offensive action, and their activation ends immediately.
- **Multi-Attack:** Makes two **Branch Slam** attacks during their attack step.
- **Root Snare:** At the start of their activation while **Guardian's Fury** is active, if one or more enemies within **8"** are not **Immobilized**, the Treant forgoes one **Branch Slam** attack and targets the nearest such enemy. That target becomes **Immobilized**.
- **Guardian's Fury:** When the Treant is attacked or the Totem is touched, Guardian's Fury becomes active immediately. While Guardian's Fury is active, the Treant abandons the ritual and uses normal AI. At the end of a round in which the Treant was not attacked, no Hero touched or carried the Totem, and the Totem is adjacent to the Treant, Guardian's Fury ends and the Treant resumes the ritual.
- **Siege Monster.**
- **Vulnerable:** fire.
- **Plant Stride:** The Treant ignores **Difficult Terrain** in forest and undergrowth areas.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** at the Mother Tree, adjacent to the Heartwood Totem.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within 8" of the Mother Tree but outside the Sacred Grove. **Resting**. Becomes **Awake** if combat occurs within the Sacred Grove.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place on an approach path to the Grove. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table. Place within 3" of one outer Treasure Chest. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties make a Setup Roll-off. The winner chooses a long battlefield edge and deploys within **6"** of that edge. The other party deploys within **6"** of the opposite long edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Ritual Progress:** Track ritual progress with a die or token (starting at 0). At the end of each round in which the Treant was not attacked, no Hero touched or carried the Totem, and the Totem is adjacent to the Treant, advance the ritual by 1 step. The ritual reaches its midpoint at step 3 and completes at step 6.

When the ritual reaches step 3, the Sacred Grove expands to **Aura 8"**, and all Heroes currently within it heal **1d6 HP**.

**Tend the Rite (Protection):** A Hero from a party that chose **Protection** and is adjacent to the Mother Tree uses **Interact [2 AP]** and makes a **SPI Check**. On a success, that party gains **1 Ward Step**, to a maximum of **1 Ward Step per party per round** and **3 Ward Steps per party**. Each Ward Step is worth **(2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** if the ritual completes. A party forfeits all Ward Steps and cannot gain more if one of its Heroes attacks the Treant or touches or carries the Heartwood Totem.

**Living Heartwood Shard:** When the Treant is defeated, they drop a Living Heartwood Shard (worth 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins) in their space. A Hero adjacent to it uses **Interact [1 AP]** to take it as a carried objective.

**Stealing the Totem:** A Hero adjacent to the Treant (or adjacent to the Totem if they have been separated) uses **Interact [3 AP]** and makes a **STR Check** to pry the Totem loose. On a success, the Hero takes the Totem. This immediately triggers Guardian's Fury.

**Blighted Intruders:** The first time Guardian's Fury becomes active while Ritual Progress is 2 or less, one additional Random Monster Group, generated by rolling once on the Greenmark Random Monster Table, appears within **3"** of the Mother Tree at the start of the next Monster Phase. This group is **Awake** and hostile to all other combatants and Monsters.

**Escape Conditions:** Required only for the Theft objective. The Hero carrying the Totem must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends after Round 8, when the Totem is carried off-map, when the ritual completes, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- **Theft win:** Escape with the Totem. Gain 6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins.
- **Protection win:** The ritual reaches step 6 with the Treant alive, and the party has **3 Ward Steps**. Each winning Protection party gains **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** from its Ward Steps plus an additional **3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. Each Hero in that party gains **Forest's Blessing**: **+1 Luck Point** for their next adventure. This may raise them **1 above** their normal maximum for that adventure.
- **If the Treant is defeated before the ritual completes and the Totem is not escaped with:** The party that dealt the most total damage to the Treant gains their CV plus **4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. If that damage is tied, neither party gains this reward.
- If no primary objective is achieved, the party with the most total Coins wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most total damage dealt to the Treant.

#### Climate 2: Ashlands Scenarios

##### Scenario 1: The Fallen Observatory [Intro]

*A star-engine once crowned these ruins, and its broken brass arms still turn when moonlight enters the cracked dome. Wizards would give a finger for the instruments scattered across the shifting floors, which is precisely why the Sable Watch wants them carried to Sablekeep and locked away from unregistered hands. The old servants of the place still know the penalty for touching them. They have a great deal of time in which to enforce it.*

**Primary Objective:** Finish with the highest total **Coin Value** under this scenario's **Victory Conditions**.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Extract the Star Lens, at least 1 Bronze Orrery Fragment, and at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Collapse** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place one large **Collapsed Dome** ruin (6"×6") at the battlefield's centre, with 4–6 broken wall sections and 3–4 rubble fields surrounding it. Place 2 raised "Observation Platforms" (2"×2", 2" high) near opposite corners of the central ruin, at least 10" from each other. Mark 3 **Unstable Floor** sections on the floor inside the dome, each at least 2" apart.

**Objective Placement:**

- Place the **Star Lens** on a central pedestal inside the dome (carried objective, 7 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins).
- Place 3 **Bronze Orrery Fragment** markers in separate ruin alcoves outside the dome (each a carried objective, 1 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins).
- Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each), one on each raised Observation Platform.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Observatory Sentinel**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (3 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 3 + (APL/4, rounded down) | 5" | APL + 1 (min 3, max 7) | 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize the valid Hero carrying the Star Lens. If no valid Hero carries it, prioritize valid Heroes inside the dome. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Arcane Beam:** 1d8 + APL/2 arcane damage, **Ranged 12"**.
  - **Stone Fist:** 1d10 + APL/2 blunt damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Construct.**
- **Rotating Lens:** At the start of the Monster Phase, the Sentinel targets one Observation Platform. The party that lost the Setup Roll-off chooses the platform during the first Monster Phase; the targeted platform then alternates each subsequent Monster Phase. Each enemy on that platform or adjacent to it suffers **1d6 arcane damage**. This effect does not apply if the Sentinel is **Engaged**.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** inside the Collapsed Dome, within **2"** of the Star Lens pedestal.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place among rubble outside the dome. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place in one side alcove. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite long battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Unstable Floors:** The first time per round a Hero ends movement in an Unstable Floor section, roll 1d6. On a 1–2, the floor collapses: that Hero falls **Prone**, suffers **1d6 blunt damage**, and the section becomes **Difficult Terrain** permanently. Collapsed sections cannot collapse again.

**Star Lens:** A Hero carrying the Star Lens counts as a **Light Source** with **Aura 3"**.

**Escape Conditions:** Heroes carrying any relic or Chest contents must escape via any battlefield edge. Heroes carrying nothing may also escape freely.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends after Round 8, when all surviving Heroes from at least one party have escaped, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party that extracts the most total Coin Value (from relics, Chests, and Monster CV) wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 2: The Guardian's Test

*A sealed gate dominates the courtyard, black with soot and old prayers, somewhere along the imperial roads that run out from the dead empire's heart. The texts say a vault waits beyond. They warn that worthiness is tested before entry, and no surviving copy explains what worthiness means. The Sable Watch insists the guardian answers to a seal nobody now holds, while a rival party arrives carrying a Hollow Crown's Writ and a very different opinion.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the first party to complete 2 of the 3 Trials and claim the Vault Keystone from the Sealed Gateway.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None. The 3 Trials are distinct and remain fixed.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Gain 3 Trial Points, open the Gateway, then extract at least half the party through the Gateway as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** One long battlefield edge contains the "Sealed Gateway", a 4–6" wall section with an archway of **Open Terrain** in its centre. The central area (about 15"×15") is an open Courtyard. Place 4–6 colonnade sections or free-standing pillars and scattered rubble around the Courtyard. Place three **Trial Pedestal** markers (1") in the Courtyard, forming a triangle with each Pedestal at least 5" from the others. Each Pedestal is labelled: **Insight**, **Might**, and **Will**.

**Objective Placement:** The Sealed Gateway and the 3 Trial Pedestals are the Primary Objectives. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) in alcoves or side chambers off the Courtyard.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Guardian Construct**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (5 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/2, rounded down) | 5" | APL + 2 (min 4, max 8) | 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize valid Heroes who are Interacting with the Gateway, then valid Heroes belonging to a party with **2** or more Trial Points. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Energy Bolt:** 1d8 + APL/2 arcane damage, **Ranged 12"**.
  - **Arcane Slam:** 1d10 + APL/2 blunt damage; **Push** the target **1"** directly away.

**Special Abilities**

- **Construct.**
- **Nullification Protocol:** When a Power, scroll, or special item effect targets the Guardian, that effect has no effect on the Guardian. Resolve it against every other target normally.
- **Awaken Protocol:** The Guardian is not placed at setup. When the first Trial Pedestal is successfully Interacted with, place the Guardian at the centre of the Courtyard. They are immediately **Awake** and hostile to all.

**Boss Deployment:** The Guardian Construct is not placed at setup. See **Awaken Protocol**.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place among the colonnades. **Resting**. Becomes **Awake** if combat occurs within the Courtyard.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Begins off-battlefield; arrives from a random edge that is neither party's deployment edge at the start of Round 3. **Awake** when it arrives.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite short battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**The Trials:** Each Pedestal may be Interacted with by Heroes from both parties but grants a Trial Point only once per party per Pedestal. A party that has already gained a Trial Point from a given Pedestal cannot gain another from it.

- **Pedestal of Insight:**
**Interact [2 AP]**: Make an **INT Check**. **Success:** Gain 1 Trial Point.
- **Pedestal of Might:**
**Interact [2 AP]**: Make a **STR Check**. **Success:** Gain 1 Trial Point.
- **Pedestal of Will:**
**Interact [2 AP]**: Make a **SPI Check**. **Success:** Gain 1 Trial Point.

A party needs 2 Trial Points to be eligible to open the Gateway.

**Opening the Gateway:** A Hero from a party with **2** or more Trial Points who is adjacent to the Sealed Gateway uses **Interact [3 AP]**. This interaction cannot be started while the Guardian Construct is **Awake**, within **6"**, and has **LOS** to that Hero. On completion, the Gateway opens and the Hero claims the **Vault Keystone** as a carried objective worth **8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. No **Check** is required; completing the Trials is the test.

**Escape Conditions:** None. The Keystone does not need to leave the battlefield.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when a party claims the Vault Keystone, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party that claims the Keystone wins and gains the Keystone's Coin Value. If the Keystone is unclaimed, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Trial Points accumulated.

##### Scenario 3: The Shifting Sands of Time

*The ruin does not keep time honestly. Glyphs flare and gutter. Soot drifts uphill in the corners. Stone that bore a traveller's weight at dawn may open beneath them by noon. Relics surface when the place remembers them and sink before anyone can make a clean claim, and the Sable Watch will register whatever is carried back to Sablekeep, whether the finder wishes it registered or not.*

**Primary Objective:** Finish with the highest total **Coin Value** under this scenario's **Victory Conditions**.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None. The 4 Unstable Ground zones are fixed scenario terrain.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Loot at least **2 Treasure Chests**, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Collapse** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place 6–8 ruined wall sections, 2–3 rocky outcrops, and one larger "Central Ruin Footprint" (4"×4" flat area, **Open Terrain**) near the battlefield centre. Mark 4 separate **Unstable Ground** zones (3"×3" each) in chokepoints or open areas near the Central Ruin, at least 6" apart.

**Objective Placement:** No Treasure Chests start on the battlefield. Chests are found during play (see Special Rules).

**Scenario-Specific Monster:** None.

**Boss Deployment:** None.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place within 4" of one Unstable Ground zone. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place within 4" of a different Unstable Ground zone. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Place patrolling the Central Ruin footprint. **Resting**.
- **Group 4:** Roll once on the Ashlands Random Monster Table. Begins off-battlefield; arrives from a randomly determined battlefield edge at the start of Round 2. **Awake** when it arrives.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy in opposite corner zones (8"×8"). Parties alternate placing Heroes within their zone, starting with the party that lost the Setup Roll-off.

**Special Rules:**

**Shifting Terrain and Hidden Treasure:** At the start of Rounds 2, 3, 4, and 5, the party that lost the Setup Roll-off chooses one Unstable Ground zone that does not yet contain a Chest. Roll 1d6 for that zone:

- **1–2:** The zone becomes **Difficult Terrain**. Place a marker. This effect is permanent for the adventure.
