**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Defeat the Frost Bailiff Magistrate, then extract either the Heartfrost Shard or the Staff of Winter and at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Build a frozen sanctum with one central throne chamber, 2 side chambers, and icy corridors connecting them. The ground is **Slippery Terrain**. Place 3–4 ice walls or frozen pillars.

**Objective Placement:** The Frost Bailiff Magistrate begins on the Ice Throne. They carry the Heartfrost Shard and the Staff of Winter. Each is a carried objective worth **5 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. Both items drop in the Frost Bailiff Magistrate's space when they are defeated. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) in side chambers.

  - **Icicle Bolt:** 1d8 + APL/2 ice damage, **Ranged 12"**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Summon Ice Mephit [Recharge 5–6]:** At the start of their activation, if fewer than 4 Ice Mephits placed by this ability are on the battlefield, the Magistrate places 1 Ice Mephit within 3". The placed Ice Mephit is **Awake** and hostile to all. This ability can place no more than 6 Ice Mephits during the adventure.

**Ice Mephits:** Use the following profile for all Ice Mephits in this scenario.

- *Ice Mephit [Minion]:* HP 8 | AV 1 | SPD 5" (Fly 6") | Sz S | LVL 2 | CV 2c. **Attacks:** Frost Claws, 1d6 ice damage. **Special Abilities:** **Small**; **Immune:** ice; **Vulnerable:** fire; **Death Burst:** when this Monster is defeated, each combatant within 1" suffers 1d4 ice damage.

**Frigid Sanctum:** At the end of each round, each combatant that is not **Resistant** or **Immune** to ice damage and is not **Engaged** suffers **1 ice damage**.

**Shattering Ice Walls:** If a Wall of Ice is destroyed by fire damage, each combatant within 1" suffers **1d4 piercing damage**. Reduce this damage by **AV** normally.

**Claiming the Magistrate's Items:** A Hero adjacent to the defeated Magistrate's space uses **Interact [1 AP]** to pick up either the Heartfrost Shard or the Staff of Winter. Picking up one item does not automatically pick up the other.

**Escape Conditions:** A Hero carrying either Magistrate item may escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends at the end of the first round in which the Frost Bailiff Magistrate is defeated and at least one party has escaped with its designated item, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- If only one party has escaped with its designated item, that party wins and gains that item's Coin Value plus an additional **2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
- If both parties have escaped with their designated items, the party with the higher total Coin Value wins.
- If neither party has escaped with its designated item, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

#### Climate 5: Sun-Drowned Scenarios

##### Scenario 1: The Oasis Raiders [Intro]

*A vital oasis south of the mountain passes has changed hands again, and raiders hold the wells, the shade, and the people too slow to flee. Saltspire sells water as sovereignty, and an oasis it does not control is a debt it cannot collect. One contract from the Well-Keepers says liberation. A rival contract says seizure. The water will not ask which seal is righteous.*

**Primary Objective:** Control the Oasis Wellspring at the end of Round 7 and have defeated the Raider Chieftain.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Defeat the Raider Chieftain, control the Wellspring at the end of a round after the Chieftain is defeated, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place a central Oasis (about 8"×8") with a Wellspring marker and 2–3 Palm Trees. Place 4–6 Sand Dunes and 2–3 Rocky Outcrops across the rest of the battlefield.

**Objective Placement:** The Wellspring is the central control point. Place 3 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) behind dunes and rock formations.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Raider Chieftain**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (3 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/4, rounded down) | 6" | APL + 1 (min 3, max 6) | 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**Attacks**
  - **Desert Scimitar:** 1d8 + APL/2 slashing damage.
  - **Throwing Knives:** 1d4 + APL/2 piercing damage, **Ranged 6"**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Desert Tactics:** Allied Monsters within **6"** gain **+1" Speed**.
- **Multi-Attack:** If **Engaged**, makes one **Desert Scimitar** attack. Otherwise, makes two **Throwing Knives** attacks during their attack step, using the normal Monster target priorities.
- **Sandstorm Dance (once per adventure):** At the start of their activation, the Chieftain creates an **Aura 3"** sandstorm centred on themselves. The area provides **Cover** and reduces ranged damage traced through it by 1 until the end of the round.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** within 2" of the Wellspring.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place within 3" of the Chieftain. **Awake**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place on a high dune overlooking the Oasis. **Resting**.
- **Group 3:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place behind a Rocky Outcrop on one approach route. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite long battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Controlling the Wellspring:** A party controls the Wellspring if, at the end of the round, it is the only party with Heroes within 2" of the Wellspring and no Monster is within 2" of the Wellspring. If both parties have Heroes within 2", or if a Monster is within 2", the Wellspring is Contested and neither party controls it. While a party controls the Wellspring, each of that party's Heroes within 2" heals 1d3 HP at the start of that Hero's activation.

**Heat Haze:** Ranged attacks targeting beyond **12"** roll their base damage dice with **Disadvantage**.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends at the end of Round 7 or when all Heroes are defeated.

- If one party controls the Wellspring at the end of Round 7 and the Raider Chieftain has been defeated, that party wins and gains 8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins.
- If the Chieftain has been defeated but neither party controls the Wellspring, the party that dealt the killing blow to the Chieftain gains **6 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
- If the Chieftain remains alive, the party that controls the Wellspring at the end of Round 7 gains 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins.
- In all other cases, and in every case above where no winner is named, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 2: The Cinder Lord's Lost Brazier

*A brass brazier lies somewhere in the scorched ruins, still holding the ember of a bound Cinder Lord. The relic promises power to the hand that completes the binding, and Saltspire knows more about binding infernal things to contracts than it admits to anyone. One patron wants the brazier brought in quietly. Another wants the binding finished out here. Promises made by fire should be read twice.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the first party to find the Lost Brazier and successfully complete the Attunement Ritual.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None. The 3 Elemental Loci are distinct steps and remain fixed.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Find the Lost Brazier, successfully complete the Attunement Ritual, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Create a ruined plaza with a central Altar of Binding (2"×2", 1" high). Scatter scorched earth, jagged obsidian rubble, and fire-blasted wall sections around the plaza. Place 3 Elemental Locus pillars (**Impassable Terrain**) 4–6" from the Altar.

**Objective Placement:** The Lost Brazier does not begin on the battlefield. It is found through searching the Elemental Loci. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) in surrounding ruins.

**Scenario-Specific Monsters: Flame Guardians (2)**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (2 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 1 + (APL/4, rounded down) | 6" (Fly 4") | APL (min 2, max 5) | (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins each | L |

**Attacks**
  - **Fiery Lash:** **Reach**, 1d6 + APL/2 fire damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Immune:** fire.
- **Cinder Burst:** At the start of the Guardian's activation, target the nearest enemy within **8"**. That target and every combatant within **1"** of them suffer **1d4 + APL/2 fire damage**, minimum **1**.
- **Bound to Locus:** A Flame Guardian cannot willingly move more than 6" from the Locus where they spawned.

**Boss Deployment:** Flame Guardians are not placed at setup. The first two successful Locus searches each spawn one Flame Guardian at that Locus, **Awake**.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place within **4"** of a randomly determined Elemental Locus. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place on an outer approach route. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite short battlefield edges, converging on the plaza.

**Special Rules:**

**Interacting with the Loci:** A Hero adjacent to an Elemental Locus uses **Interact [1 AP]** and makes an **INT Check**. Each Elemental Locus can produce at most one successful search; once a Locus has produced a success, it cannot be searched again. The first two successful **Interact** actions spawn Flame Guardians. The third successful search reveals the Lost Brazier at that Locus; place it adjacent to the searching Hero.

**Picking Up the Lost Brazier:** A Hero adjacent to the found Brazier uses **Interact [1 AP]** to take it as a carried objective.

**Using the Brazier:** A Hero carrying the Lost Brazier who is adjacent to the Altar of Binding uses **Interact [3 AP]** and makes a **SPI Check**.

- **Success:** That Hero claims the Brazier's power. Gain **8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**. That Hero also gains one **Cinder Lord's Boon** token. Once during a future adventure, before making any one d20 roll, the Hero may spend that token to treat the roll as a natural **20** for that roll's purpose, including any **Critical Success** or **Critical Cast** effect that roll triggers.
- **Failure:** The Brazier erupts. Every combatant within **2"** suffers **1d8 fire damage**. The ritual may be attempted again on a later activation.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends immediately when a party successfully claims the Brazier's power, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated. If no party claims the Brazier by the end of Round 8, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 3: Tomb of the Sunken Kings

*The sand has drawn back from a tomb complex of the priest-kings, and gilded chambers show through the heat shimmer. The old hazards remain patient, and so do the guardians. Saltspire will buy whatever is carried out and ask no awkward questions about how, because plausible innocence is worth as much to it as gold. Nothing buried with a priest-king expects to be taken politely.*

**Primary Objective:** Finish with the highest total **Coin Value** under this scenario's **Victory Conditions**.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Royal Sarcophagi.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Loot and extract the contents of at least half of the Royal Sarcophagi placed after scaling, rounded up, then extract at least half the party as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Collapse** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Build a tomb entrance complex with 5–7 wall sections forming small chambers and one Grand Hall (about 5"×10"). Scatter 3–4 Fallen Pillars and patches of Deep Sand.

**Objective Placement:** Place 3 Royal Sarcophagus markers in separate chambers. Each yields **1 Treasure roll**. When a Sarcophagus is looted, roll **1d4**. On a **4**, that Sarcophagus also contains a **Desert King's Trinket** (see **Special Rules**). Place 1 Treasure Chest (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage**) in an alcove.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Tomb Herald (Mummy)**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (5 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/3, rounded down) | 4" | APL + 2 (min 4, max 8) | 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize valid Heroes opening or looting Sarcophagi. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

1. **Desiccating Grasp [Recharge 5–6]:** If the nearest visible enemy is within **6"**, that enemy suffers **1d6 + APL necrotic damage** and cannot regain HP until the end of their next activation. Then end this activation.

**Attacks**
  - **Slam of Ages:** 1d10 + APL/2 blunt damage. If this attack damages the target, the target must pass a **STR Check** or become **Weakened**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Undead.**
- **Vulnerable:** fire.
- **Terror Aura (3"):** An enemy entering or starting an activation in the Aura makes a **SPI Check** or becomes **Frightened**.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** guarding the Royal Sarcophagus nearest the battlefield centre.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place in a side chamber near one Sarcophagus. **Resting**. It becomes **Awake** when that Sarcophagus is Interacted with.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place in a corridor leading to the Grand Hall. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy in opposite corner zones, representing different breaches into the tomb.

**Special Rules:**

**Ancient Hazards:** Before Hero deployment, roll **1d3 once** to determine the total number of Pressure Plate markers. Starting with the party that lost the Setup Roll-off, parties alternate placing that many markers in corridors, not in Deep Sand. The first Hero to move within **1"** of a Pressure Plate marker triggers it and makes a **DEX Check**. **Failure:** Roll 1d4: **1:** the Hero suffers **1d6 piercing damage** from darts; **2:** the Hero becomes **Blinded**; **3:** the Hero becomes **Immobilized**; **4:** the nearest **Resting** Monster Group becomes **Awake**. A Hero within **2"** and **LOS** of an untriggered Pressure Plate may use **Interact [1 AP]** and make an **INT Check** to neutralize it.

**Desert King's Trinket:** A Hero may carry no more than **1 Desert King's Trinket** into an adventure. At the start of an adventure, a Hero carrying a Trinket gains **+1 Luck Point** for that adventure. This may raise that Hero **1 above** their normal maximum for that adventure. A Trinket may instead be sold during the Town Phase for **(2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**, using the APL of the adventure in which it was found.

**Sarcophagus Seals:** Opening a Royal Sarcophagus requires **Interact [2 AP]** and either a **STR Check** to force it open or an **INT Check** to carefully unseal it. Looting its contents requires a separate **Interact [1 AP]**.

**Escape Conditions:** Heroes carrying Sarcophagus loot must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends at the end of Round 7, when every Royal Sarcophagus placed after scaling has been looted and all surviving Heroes from at least one party have escaped, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party that escapes with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Royal Sarcophagi successfully looted.

##### Scenario 4: The Sandwyrm's Lair

*Nomad legends speak of a vast shape beneath the dunes south of the passes, and a gullet lined with the treasure of everything they have swallowed. The nomads tell it as a warning. Saltspire's patrons hear it as an inventory and pay accordingly. The dunes do not distinguish between the two kinds of listener.*

**Primary Objective:** Defeat the Great Sandwyrm and loot the Hoard of the Wastes.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Defeat the Great Sandwyrm, loot the Hoard of the Wastes, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Pursuit** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Create a broad basin of loose desert sand with a central Shifting Sands Zone. Scatter a few rock shelves, ruined stakes, and dune ridges.

**Objective Placement:** No Hoard token begins on the battlefield. When the Sandwyrm is defeated, place the Hoard of the Wastes token in the space where they fell. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) near the edge of the basin.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Great Sandwyrm**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (6 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 3 + (APL/2, rounded down) | 6" | APL + 3 (min 6, max 10) | 4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | H |

**Attacks**
  - **Titanic Maw:** 1d12 + APL piercing damage.
  - **Bursting Slam:** 1d10 + APL/2 blunt damage. If this attack damages the target, the target makes a **STR Check** or is **Pushed 2"** directly away.

**Special Abilities**

- **Burrow and Emerge [Recharge 4–6]:** The Sandwyrm starts burrowed and off-battlefield and remains eligible to activate while in that state. On their first activation, place them within the Shifting Sands Zone; the party that lost the Setup Roll-off chooses the exact legal position for their **Huge** footprint. If no legal placement fits at the chosen point, use the nearest legal placement to that point, determining tied nearest placements using **Random Determination**. Then resolve their activation normally. On a later activation, after attacking, the Sandwyrm uses this ability if it is available and they are not **Immobilized** or **Stunned**. Remove them from the battlefield and place a Burrow marker in the space they occupied. At the start of each of the Sandwyrm's activations while burrowed, move the Burrow marker up to the Sandwyrm's Speed toward their **Primary Target**. If the marker ends that movement adjacent to their **Primary Target**, or if the Sandwyrm suffered any damage while burrowed since their previous activation, the Sandwyrm emerges: place their **Huge** footprint centred on the marker if legal; otherwise use the nearest legal placement to the marker, determining tied nearest placements using **Random Determination**. Remove the marker and resolve their activation normally. If the Sandwyrm begins an activation already burrowed and does not emerge during that activation, they emerge at the end of it: place their **Huge** footprint centred on the Burrow marker if legal, otherwise use the nearest legal placement to the marker, determining tied nearest placements using **Random Determination**. Remove the marker. The Sandwyrm does not resolve a further activation that round. The Sandwyrm therefore cannot remain burrowed through more than one of their own activations. While the Sandwyrm is burrowed, attacks and Powers may target the Burrow marker; they affect the Sandwyrm, but the Sandwyrm is treated as having **Cover** against them.
- **Swallow Whole:** If **Titanic Maw** reduces a Hero to **0 HP**, that Hero makes their Injuries Roll at **-2**. If they survive, they are swallowed under the universal **Swallow Whole** rules in **9.6**: remove them from the battlefield, mark them as swallowed by the Sandwyrm, and drop their carried objectives in the space they occupied. A swallowed Hero who remains **Knocked Out** cannot attempt to escape; a Hero restored above **0 HP** by their **Injuries Roll** may use the normal swallowed escape procedure. If the adventure ends while the Sandwyrm lives, place each surviving swallowed Hero **Prone** at the Sandwyrm's position, or at the Burrow marker if the Sandwyrm is burrowed, before resolving the Aftermath.
- **Tremorsense (9").**

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake**, off-battlefield, and burrowed.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place near a dune ridge. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place near a Treasure Chest. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Looting the Hoard:** After the Sandwyrm is defeated, a Hero adjacent to the Hoard of the Wastes uses **Interact [2 AP]** to loot it. The looting party immediately makes **3 Treasure rolls**, then rolls **1d2**. On a **1**, roll once on the Potions table matching the current treasure tier. On a **2**, roll once on the Special Items group matching the current treasure tier. At Tier 1, use Tier 2 Special Items; at Tier 5, use Tier 4 Special Items. In competitive play, the opposing party makes these rolls.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Sandwyrm is defeated and the Hoard is looted, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- The party that loots the Hoard wins.
- If the Hoard is not looted, the party with the most total Coin Value from all other sources wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most total damage dealt to the Sandwyrm.

##### Scenario 5: The Cursed Colossus of the Waste

*A colossal statue of a priest-king rises from the sand, broken at the waist and still angry, with a Heartstone lodged in their hollow chest. Fortune-hunters call it a prize. Grave-robbers know better and come anyway, and Saltspire pays the survivors of either trade the same rate. The waste keeps the ones who do not survive.*

**Primary Objective:** Retrieve the Heartstone of the Colossus from the Colossus's chest cavity and escape with it.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** Yes.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Retrieve and extract the Heartstone of the Colossus, then extract at least half the party through the same or another battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place the Colossus as a large central terrain feature (**Blocking Terrain**) with legs, shoulders, and a chest cavity that combatants may **Climb**. Surround it with dunes, broken statuary, and drifted sand. Place one 1" **Glowing Rune** marker on its back.

**Colossus Elevation:** For rules purposes, the Colossus's legs are **1"** above ground level, the **Glowing Rune** marker is **2"** above ground level, and the shoulders and chest cavity are **3"** above ground level, regardless of the physical terrain piece used.

**Objective Placement:** The Heartstone begins inside the Colossus's chest cavity as a carried objective worth 10 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) in the surrounding dunes or broken chambers at the statue's base.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Cursed Colossus**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (5 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 4 + (APL/2, rounded down) | 5" | APL + 3 (min 6, max 10) | 4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | H |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize a valid enemy carrying the Heartstone. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

1. **Falling Rubble:** If the Colossus is not **Engaged** and their **Primary Target** is more than **2"** away and within **8"**, centre an **Aura 2"** area on that target. Each combatant in the area suffers **1d8 blunt damage** and becomes **Prone**. Then end this activation.

**Attacks**
  - **Crushing Fist:** 1d12 + APL blunt damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Construct.**
- **Siege Monster.**
- **Cursed:** This Monster is permanently **Cursed** and cannot regain HP.
- **Glowing Rune Weakness:** The Glowing Rune marker is fixed to the Colossus and moves with them. A Hero attacking the Colossus while within **1"** of the Glowing Rune marker, or from a position above the Colossus, ignores the Colossus's AV.
- **Awaken Protocol:** The Colossus is inert and treated as terrain until the Heartstone is picked up for the first time or the Colossus has suffered 15 or more total damage. While inert, they are also a visible scenario object: attacks and damaging effects may target them, use their printed **AV**, and they automatically fail any Check they are required to make. Apply HP damage normally and count it toward the 15-damage threshold. They then animate immediately, become **Awake**, and are hostile to all. When the Colossus animates, every combatant on the Colossus is placed at the nearest legal ground-level space and resolves **Falling** (**4.4.10**) using their current height. While the Colossus is animated, a Hero may **Climb** them, and reach the chest cavity, only while the Colossus is **Prone**, **Immobilized**, or **Stunned**.

On animation, replace the terrain footprint with the Colossus's **Sz H** footprint centred on its former centre, or in the nearest legal space. If an animated Colossus has none of **Prone**, **Immobilized**, or **Stunned** while combatants are on it, place them in the nearest legal ground-level spaces and resolve **Falling** from their current heights before it acts or moves. Do the same before removing a defeated Colossus. Before removing the Colossus, place any uncarried Heartstone on or inside it in the nearest legal ground-level space. If the Heartstone has never been picked up, collecting it costs **Interact [2 AP]**; otherwise, use the normal carried-objective rules.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts inert and treated as terrain under **Awaken Protocol**.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place near the statue's base. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place on an outer dune approach. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Scenario Minions:** This scenario uses the **Minion Swarm** rules in **10.6.8**.

**Retrieving the Heartstone:** A Hero adjacent to the chest cavity uses **Interact [2 AP]** to take the Heartstone.

**Curse of Binding:** After the Heartstone has been picked up for the first time, and until it is escaped with, at the start of each Monster Phase the party that lost the Setup Roll-off rolls **1d2**. Place that many **Skeleton Warriors**, using the canonical bestiary entry, within **3"** of a randomly determined Hero. They are hostile to all. No more than **6 Skeleton Warriors** placed by this rule may be on the battlefield at the same time, and this rule can place no more than **8 Skeleton Warriors** during the adventure.

**Escape Conditions:** The Hero carrying the Heartstone must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Heartstone is escaped with, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- The party that escapes with the Heartstone wins and gains the Heartstone's Coin Value.
- If no party escapes with the Heartstone, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most total damage dealt to the Colossus.

##### Scenario 6: The Cinder Lord's Obsidian Prison

*An obsidian dais burns without fuel at the centre of the ruin, and a Cinder Lord strains against the binding that holds them. Saltspire's Well-Keepers wrote bindings like this one, back when the desert still kept its own law, and one of them wants the prison strengthened before it fails. A rival patron wants it broken and calls that ambition. The Cinder Lord calls it overdue.*

**Role Assignment:** Randomly determine which party is **Jailers** (Party A); the other party is **Liberators** (Party B). Roll **1d2**: on a **1**, the Setup Roll-off winner is Party A; on a **2**, the Setup Roll-off loser is Party A.

**Primary Objective:**

- **Jailers (Party A):** Reinforce every intact Glyphic Stone and maintain a majority of the placed Stones intact through the end of a round beginning with Round 4.
- **Liberators (Party B):** Shatter a majority of the placed Glyphic Stones and receive the Cinder Lord's Boon.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Glyphic Stones. A majority is more than half the number placed.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Use the **Liberators** objective. Shatter a majority of the Glyphic Stones placed after scaling, receive the Cinder Lord's Boon, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**. The **Jailers** objective is not used.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Ritual** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place a central Obsidian Dais with an **Impassable Terrain** body, climbable sides, and an **Open Terrain** upper surface with 3 Glyphic Stones (**Impassable Terrain**) arranged evenly around it. Surround the dais with scorched flagstones, broken columns, and zones of heated ground (**Difficult Terrain**).

**Objective Placement:** The Glyphic Stones placed after scaling are the primary objectives. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll** each) near the battlefield edges.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Bound Cinder Lord**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (6 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 3 + (APL/2, rounded down) | 7" (Fly 10") | APL + 4 (min 7, max 10) | 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins if defeated | L |

**AI Steps**

1. **Cinder Wall [Recharge 4–6]:** If this ability is available and two or more enemies are within **8"**, create a **6"** straight line of fire placed to include as many enemies as possible, using the Area of Effect priorities in **9.5** to resolve ties. The line blocks movement but not **LOS**. A combatant whose space overlaps it when created may leave it without taking this damage but cannot enter or cross it again by normal movement. A rule that permits movement through otherwise impassable terrain permits crossing this line; the first entry or crossing each round deals **1d8 fire damage**. Creating the wall does not itself deal damage. The wall lasts until the end of the round. Then end this activation.
2. **Cinder Volley:** If **Cinder Haste** did not trigger this activation, the Cinder Lord is not **Engaged**, and at least one visible enemy is within **10"**, make three ranged fire attacks, **Ranged 10"**, using the normal Monster target priorities. Each attack deals **1d6 + 1 fire damage**. Then end this activation.

**Attacks**
  - **Scimitar of Cinders:** 1d10 + APL/2 slashing damage + 1d6 fire damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Immune:** fire.
- **Vulnerable:** ice.
- **Cinder Haste:** At the start of their activation, if they are at or below half their **Max HP** and not already affected by this ability, their next attack before the end of their next activation rolls one additional base damage die.
- **Multi-Attack:** Makes two **Scimitar of Cinders** attacks during their attack step.
- **Wish:** See **Cinder Lord's Release** in Special Rules.

**Boss Deployment:** The Cinder Lord is not placed at setup. They appear only if the prison is broken. Two Flame Mephits start **Awake** guarding the Dais.

- *Flame Mephit [Minion]:* HP 8 | AV 1 | SPD 5" (Fly 6") | Sz S | LVL 2 | CV 2c. **Attacks:** Cinder Claws, 1d6 fire damage. **Special Abilities:** **Small**; **Immune:** fire; **Vulnerable:** ice; **Death Burst:** when this Monster is defeated, each combatant within 1" suffers 1d4 fire damage.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place near one Chest. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on the Sun-Drowned Random Monster Table. Place on an outer approach. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite short battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Glyphic Stones:** Each Glyphic Stone has HP 10 + (2 × APL) and AV 2.

**Reinforce (Party A):** A Hero adjacent to an intact, unreinforced Glyphic Stone uses **Interact [2 AP]** and makes a **SPI Check**. On a success, mark that Stone **Reinforced**. It gains **+5 Max HP** and immediately regains **5 HP**, up to its new maximum. A Stone can be Reinforced only once.

**Maintain a Reinforced Stone (Party A):** A Hero adjacent to a damaged Reinforced Stone uses **Interact [1 AP]** to restore **3 HP**, up to its maximum.

**Shatter (Party B):** A Hero may attack a Glyphic Stone normally. A Stone reduced to 0 HP is shattered and removed from play.

**Cinder Lord's Release:** When a majority of the Glyphic Stones placed after scaling have been shattered, place the Cinder Lord **Awake** at the centre of the Dais. Until the end of the round after their release, the Cinder Lord cannot attack. At the start of their next activation, if no Party B Hero has attacked them, they grant Party B one **Cinder Lord's Boon** token, carried by a Party B Hero of that party's choice (once during a future adventure, before making any one d20 roll, the bearer may spend the token to treat the roll as a natural **20** for that roll's purpose, including any **Critical Success** or **Critical Cast** effect that roll triggers). In competitive play, the adventure then ends. In solo or cooperative play, continue the adventure until the allied party satisfies its extraction requirement or another ending condition occurs. If a Party B Hero attacks the Cinder Lord before the Boon is granted, the Cinder Lord becomes hostile to all and the Boon is forfeited. If a combatant from any other side attacks the Cinder Lord before the Boon is granted, the Cinder Lord becomes hostile to every combatant that is not a Party B Hero and still grants the Boon at the start of their next activation if they are alive.

**Dais Energy:** A Hero that ends an activation on the Dais suffers **1d4 fire damage** unless they are **Resistant** or **Immune** to fire damage.

**Escape Conditions:** None in competitive play. In solo or cooperative play, allied Heroes may escape through any battlefield edge as required by the **Solo/Co-op Objective**.

**Victory Conditions:** Beginning at the end of Round 4, Party A wins if every intact Glyphic Stone is Reinforced and a majority of the Stones placed after scaling remain intact. The adventure also ends when Party B receives the Cinder Lord's Boon, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- **Party A wins** if it completes the active Jailer objective. Gain **8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins**.
- **Party B wins** if it shatters a majority of the placed Stones and receives the Cinder Lord's Boon. Gain **8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins** in addition to the Boon.
- If the Cinder Lord becomes hostile and is then defeated, the party that dealt the killing blow gains the Cinder Lord's CV. This does not replace the primary objective.
- If neither party completes its primary objective, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

#### Climate 6: The Mire Scenarios

##### Scenario 1: The Reliquary of Edrava Salttide [Intro]

*Recent floods opened a grave-house that The Mire had kept sealed for two hundred years. Edrava Salttide, the salt-coast's last great toll-lord, who fed their enemies to the tide and married four pirate-kings in succession, was laid here with a reliquary no Bastion will admit to wanting and every Bastion has quietly sent parties to find. Reedmarch knew where it lay all along and sold the location twice. Both parties enter before the dead gather the strength to close the door again. The water smells of salt. There is no ocean for eighty miles.*

**Primary Objective:** Be the first party to retrieve the Reliquary of Edrava Salttide and escape with it.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Retrieve and extract the Reliquary of Edrava Salttide, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Place a central Sunken Barrow mound with an **Impassable Terrain** exterior and a flooded interior sanctum: **Open Terrain** tagged **Shallow Water**, accessible through an open entrance. Surround it with Bog Islands, Dense Reeds, and areas of **Shallow Water**.

**Objective Placement:** Place the Reliquary on a pedestal inside the Sanctum. It is a carried objective worth 8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins; while carrying it, a Hero has **Disadvantage** on **SPI Checks** made to resist effects that cause **Frightened**. Place 3 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) on outer islands or in reeds.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Salttide's Shade**

*Edrava Salttide has not finished counting. The Mire preserved them, and it is patient. The Shade does not speak. They watch the reliquary. They watch the water. They watch every hand that reaches for what belongs to them.*

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (4 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 1 + (APL/4, rounded down) | Fly 6" | APL + 1 (min 4, max 7) | 2 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize a valid enemy carrying the Reliquary of Edrava Salttide. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Spectral Claw:** 1d8 + APL/2 necrotic damage. If this attack damages the target, the target must pass a **SPI Check** or become **Frightened**.

**Special Abilities**

- **Incorporeal.**
- **Undead.**
- **Curse of The Mire:** At the start of the Shade's activation, the nearest enemy within **8"** must pass a **STR Check** or become **Immobilized**.
- **Bound to Reliquary:** The Shade cannot willingly move more than 10" from the Reliquary, or from the Hero carrying it.

**Boss Deployment:** The Shade is not placed at setup. When any Hero first attempts to take the Reliquary, place the Shade adjacent to the Reliquary. The Shade is **Awake** when placed.

**Additional Combatants:** Roll 1d2 for Giant Leech Swarms. Place one such swarm **Awake** in the Barrow water at setup. If the result is 2, place the second swarm **Resting** in adjacent floodwater outside the Sanctum.

- *Giant Leech Swarm [Minion]:* HP 10 | AV 0 | SPD 3" (Swim 5") | Sz M | LVL 2 | CV 2c. **Attacks:** Draining Bite, 1d4 piercing damage; if this attack damages a target, that target becomes **Bleeding**. **Special Abilities:** **Amphibious**; **Resistant:** blunt, piercing, and slashing.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on The Mire Random Monster Table. Place on a Bog Island near one Chest. **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on The Mire Random Monster Table. Place patrolling murky water. **Resting**. They become **Awake** if a Hero enters that water area.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite short battlefield edges on the driest banks, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**Murky Water:** Within the Sunken Barrow mound, **LOS** through water is limited to **1"**.

**Claiming the Reliquary:** A Hero adjacent to the Reliquary uses **Interact [2 AP]** and makes a **SPI Check**. On a failure, that Hero suffers **1d6 psychic damage**, and the attempt fails. The action may be reattempted on a later activation. On a success, the Hero takes the Reliquary as a carried objective.

**Escape Conditions:** The Hero carrying the Reliquary must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Reliquary is escaped with, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated. The party that escapes with the Reliquary wins. If no party escapes with it, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 2: The Lizardfolk's Stolen Offerings

*A lizardfolk shrine in the deep fen was raided before dawn, and the Sunstone Amulet and the offering-piles were dragged off into the reeds. The lizardfolk temple-guards want it back, and they remember faces. One writ names the amulet sacred and to be returned. Another names the silver recoverable property, and Reedmarch will broker either errand for its usual cut of silence.*

**Role Assignment:** Randomly determine which party is **Priests' Agents** (Party A); the other party is **Treasure Hunters** (Party B). Roll **1d2**: on a **1**, the Setup Roll-off winner is Party A; on a **2**, the Setup Roll-off loser is Party A.

**Primary Objective:**

- **Priests' Agents (Party A):** Retrieve the Sunstone Amulet and escape with it.
- **Treasure Hunters (Party B):** Escape with more total Coin Value from the Offering Piles than Party A.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Offering Piles.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Retrieve the Sunstone Amulet and the contents of at least half of the Offering Piles placed after scaling, rounded up, then extract those objectives and at least half the party as defined in **10.6.10**.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Create a swamp encampment on raised ground with rope walkways, reed screens, and pools of **Shallow Water** around it.

**Objective Placement:** Place 3 Offering Pile markers. Parties alternate placing the Piles in the encampment, starting with the party that lost the Setup Roll-off. Prepare one **Sunstone** marker and enough **Coin** markers for the remaining Piles. Shuffle those markers face down out of both parties' sight, then randomly assign one beneath each Pile. Neither party may inspect the markers before the Piles are looted. Reveal a Pile's contents only when it is looted.

- The **Sunstone Pile** contains the Sunstone Amulet (carried objective, worth 8 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins to Party A or 4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins to Party B) plus **1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage**.
- Each **Coin Pile** yields **1 Treasure roll**.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Lizardfolk Scale-Shaman**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (3 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/4, rounded down) | 6" (Swim 6") | APL + 1 (min 3, max 6) | (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | M |

**AI Steps**

1. **Swamp Gas Orb:** If one or more enemies can be included in a legal **Aura 2"** area placed within **8"**, place the area using the Area of Effect priorities in **9.5**. Each enemy in the area becomes **Poisoned [d4]**. Then end this activation.

**Attacks**
  - **Quarterstaff:** 1d6 + APL/2 blunt damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Amphibious.**
- **Command:** Allied **Lizardfolk** within **6"** deal an additional **1 damage of that attack's primary damage type**.
- **Ritual Chant:** At the start of their activation, allied **Monsters** within **8"** gain protection until the end of the round: enemy **Casting Checks** for Powers and scrolls that target them or include them in an area have **Disadvantage**.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** in the encampment, accompanied by Swamp Goblins equal to **2 + APL/2**, maximum 6, all **Awake**.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on The Mire Random Monster Table. Place a numbered reeds marker at the encampment edge. The Monster Group is not on the battlefield until the encampment is attacked; then place the group at that marker. It becomes **Awake** at the start of the next Monster Phase.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy on opposite battlefield edges, within **6"** of their edge.

**Special Rules:**

**At Home in the Water:** A Monster with a **Swim** speed that ends their activation in **Shallow Water** while not **Engaged** becomes **Hidden**. They do not lose **Hidden** for lacking **Cover** while they remain in **Shallow Water**.

**Looting an Offering Pile:** A Hero adjacent to an Offering Pile uses **Interact [1 AP]** to loot it and immediately reveal its contents. The Hero takes those contents as carried loot. Coins and the Sunstone Amulet are not banked until the Hero escapes.

**Escape Conditions:** Required for the Sunstone Amulet and for any unbanked rewards from Offering Piles. Escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends at the end of Round 7, when every Offering Pile placed after scaling has been looted and all surviving Heroes from at least one party have escaped, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- **Party A wins** if it escapes with the Sunstone Amulet.
- **Party B wins** if Party A does not escape with the Sunstone Amulet and Party B escapes with more total Coin Value from the Offering Piles than Party A.
- If Party A does not escape with the Sunstone Amulet and Party B does not escape with more Offering Pile Coin Value than Party A, the party with the most total escaped Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most Monster CV collected.

##### Scenario 3: The Mire Titan's Fen

*A Mire Titan has claimed the bubbling fen, and glimmering geodes lie scattered through their territory like bait, because that is more or less what they are. Hunters arrive with hooks, ropes, and prayers. Thieves arrive lighter and usually leave that way. Reedmarch wants the geodes and does not much care which trade brings them in, so long as the fen stays quiet about the rest.*

**Role Assignment:** Before deployment, both parties secretly choose **The Hunt** or **The Heist**, then reveal.

**Primary Objective:**

- **The Hunt:** Defeat the Mire Titan.
- **The Heist:** Escape with at least half of the Glimmering Geodes placed after scaling, rounded up.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** Apply **10.6.9** to the Glimmering Geodes. The Heist requires extraction of half the placed Geodes, rounded up.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Use **The Hunt** objective. Defeat the Mire Titan, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**. **The Heist** objective is not used.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Swarm** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Create a central Bubbling Fen of deep mud and shallow pools, ringed by muddy banks and Razor Reeds. Place several small islands or raised hummocks within the fen.

**Objective Placement:** Place 3 Glimmering Geode markers in or near the Fen. Each is worth 3 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins when escaped with.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Mire Titan**

| HP | AV | SPD | LVL | CV | Sz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (5 × Party Size × (5 + (1 × APL))) / 2 | 2 + (APL/2, rounded down) | 5" (Swim 7") | APL + 3 (min 6, max 9) | 4 × (2 + (4 × APL)) Coins | H |

**AI Steps**

**Target Priority:** Prioritize a valid enemy carrying a Glimmering Geode, then a valid enemy in the Fen. Otherwise, use the normal Monster target priorities.

**Attacks**
  - **Bite:** 1d12 + APL piercing damage.
  - **Tentacle Slam:** **Reach**, 1d8 + APL/2 blunt damage.

**Special Abilities**

- **Amphibious.**
- **Standing Leap (5").**
- **Multi-Attack:** Makes one **Bite** attack and two **Tentacle Slam** attacks during their attack step.
- **Sticky Tongue:** At the start of the Mire Titan's activation, the nearest enemy within **4"** is **Pulled** up to **4"** directly toward the Mire Titan, stopping when adjacent, and becomes **Immobilized** until they spend **1 AP** and succeed on a **STR Check** or **DEX Check** to escape.
- **Swallow Whole:** If the Mire Titan's **Bite** reduces an **Immobilized** Hero to **0 HP**, resolve **5.8** normally. If the Hero survives, they are swallowed under **9.6 Swallow Whole**. This scenario version deals no ongoing swallow damage. Do not make a second **Injuries Roll**. Any other target reduced to **0 HP** is removed normally.
- **Shocking Bile:** After a melee attack that deals more than **10 damage** to this Monster after mitigation resolves, the attacker suffers **1d8 lightning damage**.

**Boss Deployment:** Starts **Awake** in the Fen.

**Random Monster Setup:**

- **Group 1:** Roll once on The Mire Random Monster Table. Place a numbered Razor Reeds marker near one Geode. The Monster Group is not on the battlefield until a Hero enters or uses **Interact** within **6"** of that marker; then place the group at that marker, **Resting**.
- **Group 2:** Roll once on The Mire Random Monster Table. Place on a muddy bank overlooking the Fen. **Resting**.

**Party Deployment:** Parties deploy in opposite corner zones on the outer banks.

**Special Rules:**

**Looting Geodes:** A Hero adjacent to a Glimmering Geode uses **Interact [1 AP]** to take it as a carried objective.

**Escape Conditions:** Required only for **The Heist**. Heroes carrying Geodes must escape via any battlefield edge.

**Victory Conditions:** The adventure ends when the Mire Titan is defeated, when a party escapes with at least half of the Geodes placed after scaling, rounded up, after Round 8, or when all Heroes are defeated.

- A party pursuing **The Hunt** wins if one of its Heroes deals the killing blow to the Mire Titan.
- A party pursuing **The Heist** wins if it escapes with at least half of the Geodes placed after scaling, rounded up.
- If neither party achieves its declared objective, the party with the most total Coin Value wins.

**Tiebreaker:** Most total damage dealt to the Mire Titan.

##### Scenario 4: The Blighted Heartwood

*Blight has wrapped the swamp growth around a pulsing Heartwood that beats under the bark like a buried organ. One patron wants it destroyed before the rot spreads to the ferry-roads Reedmarch lives on. Another wants its corruption bottled and carried off, and neither wants to be the one holding it on the way home. The Marsh Council would prefer the whole matter stay unspoken.*

**Role Assignment:** Randomly determine which party is **Cleansers** (Party A); the other party is **Corruptors** (Party B). Roll **1d2**: on a **1**, the Setup Roll-off winner is Party A; on a **2**, the Setup Roll-off loser is Party A.

**Primary Objective:**

- **Cleansers (Party A):** Destroy the Blighted Heartwood.
- **Corruptors (Party B):** Complete 3 Syphon Steps before the Heartwood is destroyed.

**Final Random Monster Groups:** Determine using **10.6.4**.

**Awake Groups:** Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a listed setup rule says otherwise. Scenario-specific Monsters use their listed state.

**Minion Swarm:** No.

**Objective Scaling:** None.

**Level Scaling:** Use the Scenario APL for every APL-based Monster, hazard, objective, reward, and damage value in this scenario.

**Solo/Co-op Objective:** Use the **Cleansers** objective. Destroy the Blighted Heartwood, then extract at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**. The **Corruptors** objective is not used.

**Pressure Clock:** Use **Ritual** from **10.5.7**.

**Battlefield and Terrain (36"×36"):** Create a central Blighted Grove (about 8"×8") with the Heartwood at its centre. Fill the Grove with Thorny Vines (**Cover Terrain** tagged **Difficult Terrain**, **Dangerous Terrain**, and **Natural**) that deal **1 piercing damage** when entered. Surround it with **Shallow Water**, Twisted Mangroves, and Corrupted Muck.

**Objective Placement:** The Heartwood has HP **20 + (10 × APL)** and AV **2 + (APL/3, rounded down)**. It is **Vulnerable:** fire and holy, and **Resistant** to necrotic and poison. Place 2 Treasure Chests (**1 Treasure roll with Disadvantage** each) in Corrupted Muck areas.

**Scenario-Specific Monster: Blighted Treant Guardian**

**AI Steps**
